# FSSAI Registration: Apply for Food License Online in India

FSSAI Registration is mandatory for every food business operator in India to ensure food safety and quality standards. The **Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)** regulates food businesses by issuing a **[food license registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-license)** that establishes legal compliance, builds consumer trust, and enables smooth business operations across India.

## What is FSSAI Registration?

**FSSAI Registration** is a mandatory legal requirement under the **Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006**, for all food business operators (FBOs) in India. It is issued by the **Food Safety and Standards Authority of India**, a statutory body under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India.

Every food business — whether a restaurant, food importer, or home-based food operator — must obtain an **FSSAI certificate** before commencing operations. The **FSSAI registration number** is a 14-digit unique number that must be displayed on all food product labels and packaging.

The **food license online** registration process is managed through the **FoSCoS (Food Safety Compliance System)** portal, which replaced the erstwhile FLRS portal. [Read our essential guide on FSSAI registration in India](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai/fssai-registration-in-india-essential-guide) to understand the complete process in detail.

## What are the Different Types of FSSAI Registration?

Based on the size, scale, and nature of the **food business license India**, FSSAI offers three types of registrations. Choosing the right type is crucial for **food safety compliance** and avoiding penalties.

| Type | Eligibility | Annual Turnover | Issuing Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **FSSAI Basic Registration** | Small food businesses, petty food operators | Up to Rs. 1.5 Cr | Local Authority / Designated Officer |
| **FSSAI State License** | Medium-scale food businesses operating within one state | More than 1.5 Cr to 50 Cr | State Food Safety Authority |
| **FSSAI Central License** | Large food businesses, importers, exporters, multi-state operators | Above ₹50 Crores | Central Government / FSSAI HQ |

### FSSAI Basic Registration

**FSSAI Basic Registration** is applicable for small and petty food business operators with an annual turnover of up to ₹12 lakhs. This includes home-based food businesses, small tea stalls, and small-scale food manufacturers. The [FSSAI registration process for your business](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai/how-to-register-fssai-for-your-business) starts with identifying whether basic registration is the right fit for your operations.

### FSSAI State License

The **FSSAI State License** is required for medium-scale **food business registration India** operators with an annual turnover between ₹12 lakhs and ₹20 crores. This includes mid-size restaurants, food processors, distributors, and retailers operating within a single state. [Understand the FSSAI license requirements](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-license/understand-the-fssai-license-requirements) for state-level operations in detail.

### FSSAI Central License

The **FSSAI Central License** is mandatory for large-scale food operators with an annual turnover exceeding ₹20 crores, importers, exporters, and businesses operating across multiple states. **Food importer license India** applicants must mandatorily obtain a central license before importing any food product into India. Explore [FSSAI License](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-license) options to determine the right category for your business.

## Who Needs to Apply for FSSAI Registration?

The following **food business registration India** operators are mandatorily required to obtain an **FSSAI food license apply** certificate before commencing operations:

- **Food Manufacturers** – All units engaged in processing, packaging, or manufacturing food products
- **Food Traders & Distributors** – Wholesalers, distributors, and **food trader license** holders
- **Restaurants & Hotels** – All food service establishments including **restaurant FSSAI license** applicants
- **Cloud Kitchens** – Online food delivery businesses requiring **cloud kitchen FSSAI registration**
- **Food Importers & Exporters** – Businesses dealing in **food export license India** or import operations
- **Home-Based Food Businesses** – Home cooks and bakers selling food products online or offline
- **Food Retailers** – Supermarkets, grocery stores requiring **food retailer license**
- **Catering Services** – Event caterers and institutional food service providers
- **Food Packaging Units** – Businesses involved in **food packaging license India** operations
- **Dairy & Meat Processing Units** – All dairy farms, slaughterhouses, and meat processing plants

Read our [comprehensive guide on FSSAI registration for food businesses](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai/fssai-registration-for-food-businesses-a-comprehensive-guide) to understand eligibility in detail.

## What are the Documents Required for FSSAI Registration?

The documents required vary based on the type of **FSSAI license registration**. Here is a complete checklist:

| Document | Basic Registration | State License | Central License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Photo ID Proof of Applicant | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Address Proof of Business | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Passport Size Photograph | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Business Registration Certificate | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Food Safety Management Plan | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| List of Food Products | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| NOC from Municipality / Panchayat | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Import Export Code (IEC) | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ (for importers) |
| Partnership Deed / MoA / AoA | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Water Test Report | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |

## What is the FSSAI Registration Process?

The **FSSAI registration process step by step** is carried out through the **FoSCoS portal**. Here is how to **apply for FSSAI license online**:

1. **Step 1 – Visit FoSCoS Portal** – Go to the official Food Safety Compliance System (FoSCoS) portal and create an account.
2. **Step 2 – Select Registration Type** – Choose between Basic Registration, State License, or Central License based on your **food business license India** category.
3. **Step 3 – Fill Application Form** – Complete Form A (for Basic Registration) or Form B (for State/Central License) with accurate business details.
4. **Step 4 – Upload Documents** – Upload all required documents including identity proof, address proof, and business registration certificate.
5. **Step 5 – Pay Registration Fees** – Pay the applicable **FSSAI registration fees** online through the portal.
6. **Step 6 – Submit Application** – Review and submit the completed application for processing by the designated authority.
7. **Step 7 – Inspection (if applicable)** – The designated officer may conduct an inspection of the food premises for State and Central License applicants.
8. **Step 8 – Receive FSSAI Certificate** – Upon approval, [download your FSSAI certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai/download-fssai-certificate) from the portal.

## What is the FSSAI Registration Inspection and Approval Process?

For **FSSAI State License** and **FSSAI Central License** applications, an inspection of the food premises is conducted by the designated food safety officer. Here is the complete inspection and approval process:

1. **Application Submission** – Submit the completed application with all required documents on the FoSCoS portal.
2. **Scrutiny by Designated Officer** – The designated officer reviews the application within **7 working days** of submission.
3. **Inspection Scheduling** – If required, a physical inspection of the food premises is scheduled within **30 days** of application.
4. **Premises Inspection** – The food safety officer inspects hygiene standards, infrastructure, equipment, and **food safety compliance** measures.
5. **Inspection Report Submission** – The officer submits an inspection report to the licensing authority within **7 days** of inspection.
6. **Grant or Rejection** – Based on the inspection report, the license is either granted or the applicant is notified of deficiencies to be rectified.
7. **Certificate Issuance** – Upon successful approval, the **FSSAI registration certificate** is issued and available for download.

| Stage | Basic Registration | State License | Central License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Application Processing | 7 Days | 30 Days | 60 Days |
| Inspection Required | No | Yes (if needed) | Yes |
| Total Approval Time | 7–10 Days | 30–45 Days | 45–60 Days |

## What are the Fees for FSSAI Registration?

The **FSSAI registration fees** vary based on the type of license and the category of food business. Here is the official fee structure:

| Registration Type | Annual Fee | Duration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **FSSAI Basic Registration** | ₹100 per year | 1 – 5 Years |
| **FSSAI State License** (Category A) | ₹2,000 per year | 1 – 5 Years |
| **FSSAI State License** (Category B) | ₹3,000 – ₹5,000 per year | 1 – 5 Years |
| **FSSAI Central License** | ₹7,500 per year | 1 – 5 Years |

## What is the Validity of FSSAI License?

The **FSSAI license validity** ranges from 1 to 5 years depending on the period chosen by the applicant at the time of registration. It is important to track the expiry date to ensure timely **FSSAI renewal online** and avoid penalties for operating with an expired license.

| License Type | Minimum Validity | Maximum Validity | Renewal Required Before |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FSSAI Basic Registration | 1 Year | 5 Years | 30 Days before expiry |
| FSSAI State License | 1 Year | 5 Years | 30 Days before expiry |
| FSSAI Central License | 1 Year | 5 Years | 30 Days before expiry |

## What is the FSSAI License Renewal Process?

The **FSSAI renewal online** process must be initiated at least 30 days before the expiry of the existing license to avoid penalties and disruption of business operations. [Streamline your FSSAI renewal process easily](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-renewal/streamline-your-fssai-renewal-process-easily) with IndiaFilings expert assistance.

1. **Step 1** – Log in to the **FoSCoS portal** using your registered credentials.
2. **Step 2** – Navigate to the **Renewal Application** section and select your existing license.
3. **Step 3** – Verify and update business details if there are any changes.
4. **Step 4** – Upload updated documents if required for the **FSSAI license renewal online**.
5. **Step 5** – Pay the applicable renewal fees online through the portal.
6. **Step 6** – Submit the application and track the status on the portal.
7. **Step 7** – Receive the renewed **FSSAI registration certificate** upon approval.

Explore the complete [FSSAI Renewal](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-renewal) process and ensure your food business remains legally compliant at all times.

## What are the Penalties for Non-Compliance with FSSAI?

Operating a food business without a valid **food safety license** or violating **food safety standards India** can attract severe penalties under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Here is the penalty structure for **FSSAI non-compliance penalty**:

| Offence | Penalty |
| --- | --- |
| Selling food not meeting safety standards | Up to ₹5 Lakhs |
| Sub-standard food products | Up to ₹5 Lakhs |
| Misleading advertisements | Up to ₹10 Lakhs |
| Unsafe food causing injury | Up to ₹3 Lakhs |
| Unsafe food causing grievous injury or death | Up to ₹5 Lakhs + Imprisonment |
| Operating without FSSAI registration | Up to ₹5 Lakhs + Business closure |
| Violating directions of Food Safety Officer | Up to ₹2 Lakhs |

## How to Check FSSAI Registration Status Online?

You can easily track your **FSSAI registration online** application status through the FoSCoS portal. [Track your FSSAI application status](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai/fssai-application-status-tracking) with IndiaFilings for real-time updates.

1. **Step 1** – Visit the official **FoSCoS portal** at foscos.fssai.gov.in.
2. **Step 2** – Click on **"Track Application"** on the homepage.
3. **Step 3** – Enter your **Application Reference Number** received at the time of submission.
4. **Step 4** – Enter the captcha and click **"Search"**.
5. **Step 5** – View the current status of your **FSSAI food license apply** application.
6. **Step 6** – If approved, [download your FSSAI certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai/download-fssai-certificate) directly from the portal.

## What are the Common Mistakes to Avoid in FSSAI Registration?

Many applicants face delays or rejections due to avoidable errors in the **FSSAI registration process step by step**. Here are the most **common mistakes in FSSAI registration process** to watch out for:

- **Choosing Wrong License Type** – Applying for basic registration when a state or central license is required based on turnover.
- **Incorrect Business Category** – Selecting the wrong food business category leading to application rejection.
- **Incomplete Documentation** – Submitting applications without all required documents causing processing delays.
- **Wrong Address Details** – Mismatch between address proof and registered business address.
- **Incorrect Food Product List** – Not listing all food products manufactured or traded by the business.
- **Missing Renewal Deadline** – Failing to apply for **FSSAI renewal online** 30 days before expiry.
- **Non-Display of FSSAI Number** – Not displaying the **FSSAI registration number** on food product labels and packaging.
- **Operating with Expired License** – Continuing food business operations after the **FSSAI license validity** has expired.

## What are the Benefits of FSSAI Registration?

Obtaining a valid **food license registration** offers numerous advantages for food businesses in India:

- **Legal Compliance** – Ensures your business operates legally under the **Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006**.
- **Consumer Trust** – Builds confidence among consumers about the quality and safety of your food products.

## Frequently asked questions

Common questions aboutFSSAI Business License Registration Online in India.

Who are exempted from FSSAI registration?

- Individual members manufacturing or conducting food business activities from home for a registered Cooperative Society or Mahila Udyog or Self Help Group or Gruh Udyog, or any similar government-registered society
- The Direct Selling entity is willing to take responsibility for its Direct Sellers and has given them written authorization to do so
- A milkman/vendor registers with a Cooperative Society and sells his whole milk production to that society.
- The delivery person, direct selling agent, or owner of food vending machines, water vending machines, food ATMs, or food carts.

Can we start a business without FSSAI?

No. To ensure safe and wholesome food for human consumption, FSSAI Act requires licenses from FSSAI for every food business set up. It’s important for all the Food Business Operators to obtain a 14-digit FSSAI License Number and print it on all the food products they own.

To get more details on consequences of starting a business without an FSSAI license under Food Safety Norms.

Is GST required for FSSAI?

FSSAI, on July 27th, 2022 vide a notice announced that GST at the prescribed rate would be applicable on all services provided by FSSAI like issuing a Central license, Food Safety Mitra Fees, Product Approval Fees, Import Clearance Fees, and so forth will attract an 18% service tax.

What is the validity of FSSAI registration?

FSSAI registration or FSSAI license is valid for one year or five years, depending on the food license fees paid to the Government.

How to renew FSSAI license/Registration after expiry?

From October 1, 2021, the FSSAI has mandated for all food business to FSSAI registration or FSSAI license number on invoices and bills. Food Business Operators can renew the FSSAI License/Registration even after the expiry date with the following penalties: Three times the existing annual registration/FSSAI license fee in the period – 1st day to 90th day from the original expiry date. Additional two times of the existing annual registration/FSSAI license fee (i.e., total five times) in the period – 91st day to 180th day from the original expiry date.

What is FSSAI Registration?

FSSAI Registration is a mandatory authorisation for food business operators in India, ensuring that food products meet safety and quality standards set by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.

Who needs to get FSSAI Registration?

All food business operators involved in manufacturing, processing, storage, distribution, or sale of food products must obtain FSSAI Registration or License based on their business size and turnover.

What are the types of FSSAI Registration?

There are three types: Basic Registration (for turnover under ₹12 lakh), State License (for turnover between ₹12 lakh and ₹20 crore), and Central License (for turnover above ₹20 crore).

Who issues the FSSAI Certificate?

The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) issues the certificate after successful registration or licensing of the food business.

What details are mentioned on the FSSAI Certificate?

It includes the 14-digit FSSAI registration or license number, name of the business, address, validity period, and the photograph of the licensee.

How long is the FSSAI Certificate valid?

The validity ranges from 1 to 5 years depending on the business’s choice and type of registration/license.

Can I operate my food business without an FSSAI Certificate?

No, operating without an FSSAI Certificate or valid registration/license is illegal and subject to penalties.

How do I get the FSSAI Certificate after registration?

After your application is approved and verified by the authorities, the certificate is issued and can be downloaded from the FoSCoS portal or sent via email.

How long does FSSAI Registration take?

FSSAI Registration is usually granted within 7-15 working days if all documents are correct and the application is complete.

How much does it cost to obtain the FSSAI Certificate?

process_sections.heading: What is FSSAI Registration?
process_sections.content:
**FSSAI Registration** is a mandatory legal requirement under the **Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006**, for all food business operators (FBOs) in India. It is issued by the **Food Safety and Standards Authority of India**, a statutory body under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India.

Every food business — whether a restaurant, food importer, or home-based food operator — must obtain an **FSSAI certificate** before commencing operations. The **FSSAI registration number** is a 14-digit unique number that must be displayed on all food product labels and packaging.

The **food license online** registration process is managed through the **FoSCoS (Food Safety Compliance System)** portal, which replaced the erstwhile FLRS portal. [Read our essential guide on FSSAI registration in India](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai/fssai-registration-in-india-essential-guide) to understand the complete process in detail.

process_sections.heading: What are the Different Types of FSSAI Registration?
process_sections.content:
Based on the size, scale, and nature of the **food business license India**, FSSAI offers three types of registrations. Choosing the right type is crucial for **food safety compliance** and avoiding penalties.

| Type | Eligibility | Annual Turnover | Issuing Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **FSSAI Basic Registration** | Small food businesses, petty food operators | Up to Rs. 1.5 Cr | Local Authority / Designated Officer |
| **FSSAI State License** | Medium-scale food businesses operating within one state | More than 1.5 Cr to 50 Cr | State Food Safety Authority |
| **FSSAI Central License** | Large food businesses, importers, exporters, multi-state operators | Above ₹50 Crores | Central Government / FSSAI HQ |

process_sections.heading: FSSAI Basic Registration

process_sections.heading: What is the FSSAI Registration Process?
process_sections.content:
The **FSSAI registration process step by step** is carried out through the **FoSCoS portal**. Here is how to **apply for FSSAI license online**:

1. **Step 1 – Visit FoSCoS Portal** – Go to the official Food Safety Compliance System (FoSCoS) portal and create an account.
2. **Step 2 – Select Registration Type** – Choose between Basic Registration, State License, or Central License based on your **food business license India** category.
3. **Step 3 – Fill Application Form** – Complete Form A (for Basic Registration) or Form B (for State/Central License) with accurate business details.
4. **Step 4 – Upload Documents** – Upload all required documents including identity proof, address proof, and business registration certificate.
5. **Step 5 – Pay Registration Fees** – Pay the applicable **FSSAI registration fees** online through the portal.
6. **Step 6 – Submit Application** – Review and submit the completed application for processing by the designated authority.
7. **Step 7 – Inspection (if applicable)** – The designated officer may conduct an inspection of the food premises for State and Central License applicants.
8. **Step 8 – Receive FSSAI Certificate** – Upon approval, [download your FSSAI certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai/download-fssai-certificate) from the portal.

process_sections.heading: What is the FSSAI Registration Inspection and Approval Process?
process_sections.content:
For **FSSAI State License** and **FSSAI Central License** applications, an inspection of the food premises is conducted by the designated food safety officer. Here is the complete inspection and approval process:

1. **Application Submission** – Submit the completed application with all required documents on the FoSCoS portal.
2. **Scrutiny by Designated Officer** – The designated officer reviews the application within **7 working days** of submission.
3. **Inspection Scheduling** – If required, a physical inspection of the food premises is scheduled within **30 days** of application.
4. **Premises Inspection** – The food safety officer inspects hygiene standards, infrastructure, equipment, and **food safety compliance** measures.
5. **Inspection Report Submission** – The officer submits an inspection report to the licensing authority within **7 days** of inspection.
6. **Grant or Rejection** – Based on the inspection report, the license is either granted or the applicant is notified of deficiencies to be rectified.
7. **Certificate Issuance** – Upon successful approval, the **FSSAI registration certificate** is issued and available for download.

| Inspection Required | No | Yes (if needed) | Yes |

- **Incomplete Documentation** – Submitting applications without all required documents causing processing delays.

- **Incorrect Food Product List** – Not listing all food products manufactured or traded by the business.
- **Missing Renewal Deadline** – Failing to apply for **FSSAI renewal online** 30 days before expiry.
- **Non-Display of FSSAI Number** – Not displaying the **FSSAI registration number** on food product labels and packaging.
- **Operating with Expired License** – Continuing food business operations after the **FSSAI license validity** has expired.

all_sections.heading: What is the FSSAI Registration Process?
all_sections.content:
The **FSSAI registration process step by step** is carried out through the **FoSCoS portal**. Here is how to **apply for FSSAI license online**:

1. **Step 1 – Visit FoSCoS Portal** – Go to the official Food Safety Compliance System (FoSCoS) portal and create an account.
2. **Step 2 – Select Registration Type** – Choose between Basic Registration, State License, or Central License based on your **food business license India** category.
3. **Step 3 – Fill Application Form** – Complete Form A (for Basic Registration) or Form B (for State/Central License) with accurate business details.
4. **Step 4 – Upload Documents** – Upload all required documents including identity proof, address proof, and business registration certificate.
5. **Step 5 – Pay Registration Fees** – Pay the applicable **FSSAI registration fees** online through the portal.
6. **Step 6 – Submit Application** – Review and submit the completed application for processing by the designated authority.
7. **Step 7 – Inspection (if applicable)** – The designated officer may conduct an inspection of the food premises for State and Central License applicants.
8. **Step 8 – Receive FSSAI Certificate** – Upon approval, [download your FSSAI certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai/download-fssai-certificate) from the portal.

all_sections.heading: What is the FSSAI Registration Inspection and Approval Process?
all_sections.content:
For **FSSAI State License** and **FSSAI Central License** applications, an inspection of the food premises is conducted by the designated food safety officer. Here is the complete inspection and approval process:

1. **Application Submission** – Submit the completed application with all required documents on the FoSCoS portal.
2. **Scrutiny by Designated Officer** – The designated officer reviews the application within **7 working days** of submission.
3. **Inspection Scheduling** – If required, a physical inspection of the food premises is scheduled within **30 days** of application.
4. **Premises Inspection** – The food safety officer inspects hygiene standards, infrastructure, equipment, and **food safety compliance** measures.
5. **Inspection Report Submission** – The officer submits an inspection report to the licensing authority within **7 days** of inspection.
6. **Grant or Rejection** – Based on the inspection report, the license is either granted or the applicant is notified of deficiencies to be rectified.
7. **Certificate Issuance** – Upon successful approval, the **FSSAI registration certificate** is issued and available for download.

| Stage | Basic Registration | State License | Central License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Application Processing | 7 Days | 30 Days | 60 Days |
| Inspection Required | No | Yes (if needed) | Yes |
| Total Approval Time | 7–10 Days | 30–45 Days | 45–60 Days |

all_sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
all_sections.content:
Common questions aboutFSSAI Business License Registration Online in India.

Who are exempted from FSSAI registration?

- Individual members manufacturing or conducting food business activities from home for a registered Cooperative Society or Mahila Udyog or Self Help Group or Gruh Udyog, or any similar government-registered society
- The Direct Selling entity is willing to take responsibility for its Direct Sellers and has given them written authorization to do so
- A milkman/vendor registers with a Cooperative Society and sells his whole milk production to that society.
- The delivery person, direct selling agent, or owner of food vending machines, water vending machines, food ATMs, or food carts.

Can we start a business without FSSAI?

No. To ensure safe and wholesome food for human consumption, FSSAI Act requires licenses from FSSAI for every food business set up. It’s important for all the Food Business Operators to obtain a 14-digit FSSAI License Number and print it on all the food products they own.

To get more details on consequences of starting a business without an FSSAI license under Food Safety Norms.

Is GST required for FSSAI?

FSSAI, on July 27th, 2022 vide a notice announced that GST at the prescribed rate would be applicable on all services provided by FSSAI like issuing a Central license, Food Safety Mitra Fees, Product Approval Fees, Import Clearance Fees, and so forth will attract an 18% service tax.

What is the validity of FSSAI registration?

FSSAI registration or FSSAI license is valid for one year or five years, depending on the food license fees paid to the Government.

How to renew FSSAI license/Registration after expiry?

From October 1, 2021, the FSSAI has mandated for all food business to FSSAI registration or FSSAI license number on invoices and bills. Food Business Operators can renew the FSSAI License/Registration even after the expiry date with the following penalties: Three times the existing annual registration/FSSAI license fee in the period – 1st day to 90th day from the original expiry date. Additional two times of the existing annual registration/FSSAI license fee (i.e., total five times) in the period – 91st day to 180th day from the original expiry date.

What is FSSAI Registration?

FSSAI Registration is a mandatory authorisation for food business operators in India, ensuring that food products meet safety and quality standards set by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.

Who needs to get FSSAI Registration?

All food business operators involved in manufacturing, processing, storage, distribution, or sale of food products must obtain FSSAI Registration or License based on their business size and turnover.

What are the types of FSSAI Registration?

There are three types: Basic Registration (for turnover under ₹12 lakh), State License (for turnover between ₹12 lakh and ₹20 crore), and Central License (for turnover above ₹20 crore).

Who issues the FSSAI Certificate?

The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) issues the certificate after successful registration or licensing of the food business.

What details are mentioned on the FSSAI Certificate?

It includes the 14-digit FSSAI registration or license number, name of the business, address, validity period, and the photograph of the licensee.

How long is the FSSAI Certificate valid?

The validity ranges from 1 to 5 years depending on the business’s choice and type of registration/license.

Can I operate my food business without an FSSAI Certificate?

No, operating without an FSSAI Certificate or valid registration/license is illegal and subject to penalties.

How do I get the FSSAI Certificate after registration?

After your application is approved and verified by the authorities, the certificate is issued and can be downloaded from the FoSCoS portal or sent via email.

How long does FSSAI Registration take?

FSSAI Registration is usually granted within 7-15 working days if all documents are correct and the application is complete.

How much does it cost to obtain the FSSAI Certificate?

The cost varies depending on the type of registration/license—Basic Registration is nominal, while State and Central Licenses have higher fees.

What documents are required for FSSAI Registration?

General documents include identity proof, business registration certificate, proof of premises possession, food safety plan, list of food products, and bank details.

Is FSSAI Registration compulsory for home-based food businesses?

Yes, all food business operators, including home-based kitchens and small vendors, must obtain FSSAI Registration.

Can I apply for FSSAI Registration online?

Yes, you can apply online through the official FoSCoS portal or use expert services like IndiaFilings to simplify the process.

How much does FSSAI Registration cost?

Basic Registration fees are usually nominal (around ₹100), while State and Central Licenses have higher fees based on the business scale.

What is the validity period of FSSAI Registration?

FSSAI Registration can be valid for 1 to 5 years, depending on the business type and applicant’s choice.

What happens if I operate without FSSAI Registration?

Operating without FSSAI Registration is illegal and may lead to penalties, fines, or business closure.

What is the difference between FSSAI Registration and FSSAI License?

Registration is for small businesses with limited turnover, whereas License is mandatory for medium and large businesses with higher turnover.

How do I know which FSSAI Registration type I need?

It depends on your annual turnover and business scale. Small vendors need Basic Registration; mid-sized businesses require State License, and large businesses need Central License.

Can FSSAI Registration be renewed?

Yes, FSSAI Registration must be renewed before expiry to avoid penalties and ensure continued compliance.

Does FSSAI Registration cover all food products?

Yes, it covers all food products, including manufacturing, processing, storage, distribution, and sale.

Can I display the FSSAI Registration number on food packaging?

Yes, displaying the 14-digit FSSAI Registration number on food packages is mandatory for consumer awareness and compliance.

Is FSSAI Registration required for food importers and exporters?

Yes, all food importers and exporters must obtain FSSAI Registration or License to operate legally.

Can I transfer my FSSAI Registration to another business or location?

No, FSSAI Registration is non-transferable. You must apply for a new registration if the business ownership or location changes.

Can IndiaFilings help me get my FSSAI Certificate?

Yes, IndiaFilings provides end-to-end assistance in preparing, submitting, and following up on your FSSAI application to get your certificate smoothly.

What is an FSSAI Certificate?

The FSSAI Certificate is an official document issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India that certifies a food business’s compliance with food safety and hygiene standards.

# FSSAI Registration Certificate Renewal Online India

Every food business operator in India holding a valid **FSSAI registration certificate** must renew it before the expiry date to continue operating legally. The [FSSAI license renewal process](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-renewal/fssai-license-renewal-process-in-india) is governed by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India under the FSS Act, 2006. Whether you hold a basic registration, state license, or central license, timely **FSSAI renewal online** ensures uninterrupted business operations and full food safety compliance India.

## What is FSSAI Registration Certificate Renewal in India?

FSSAI registration certificate renewal is the process of extending the validity of your existing food license or basic registration before it lapses. All food businesses — from small home-based operators to large manufacturers — are required to renew their certificates periodically to remain compliant with India's food safety regulations.

The **FSSAI certificate validity** ranges from one to five years depending on the type of license chosen at the time of initial registration. Renewal must be initiated at least 30 days before the expiry date to avoid penalties. Failure to renew on time attracts a late fee and may result in cancellation of the **food safety license India**.

- Basic registration is valid for 1 to 5 years as chosen by the applicant
- State and central licenses carry a validity of 1 to 5 years based on fee paid
- Renewal applications must be submitted before the expiry date on the FoSCoS portal
- A late renewal attracts a penalty of Rs. 100 per day beyond the expiry date

## Who Needs to Renew Their FSSAI License in India?

Every food business operator holding any category of FSSAI license or registration is required to complete the renewal process before expiry. Understanding which category applies to your business is critical to ensuring the correct renewal form and fee are submitted through the **FSSAI FoSCoS portal renewal**.

The **FSSAI renewal eligibility** covers all entities engaged in food manufacturing, processing, storage, distribution, transportation, and retail. Explore the detailed [difference between FSSAI basic registration and license](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-license/fssai-registration-vs-license-key-differences-explained) to understand which renewal category applies to your food business.

| Business Type | License Category | Renewal Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Small food vendors, petty retailers | Basic Registration | Yes |
| Mid-size manufacturers, storage units | State License | Yes |
| Large manufacturers, importers, exporters | Central License | Yes |
| Restaurants, cloud kitchens, caterers | State License | Yes |
| E-commerce food businesses | Central License | Yes |

## What Documents Are Required for FSSAI Renewal in India?

Submitting the correct set of documents is essential to ensure a smooth and rejection-free **FSSAI renewal process India**. The documents required vary slightly depending on whether you are renewing a basic registration, state license, or central license on the FoSCoS portal.

Keeping your documents ready before initiating the renewal saves time and prevents application delays. Refer to the [5 key steps for food license renewal compliance](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-renewal/food-license-renewal-5-key-steps-for-compliance) to ensure all documentation is in order before submission.

- Existing FSSAI license or registration certificate copy
- Photo ID and address proof of the proprietor or authorized signatory
- Proof of business address (rental agreement or ownership document)
- List of food products to be manufactured or handled
- Form B duly completed and signed by the authorized person
- NOC from the municipality or local body (if applicable)
- Food safety management plan or certificate (for central license renewals)
- Annual turnover declaration for determining the appropriate license category

## How Does the FSSAI Renewal Process Work Online in India?

The step-by-step FSSAI renewal process on FoSCoS portal India is straightforward when completed with the correct information and documents. All renewals are processed digitally through the Food Safety Compliance System (FoSCoS) managed by FSSAI. Understanding the [duration for FSSAI renewal](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-renewal/understanding-the-duration-for-fssai-renewal) helps businesses plan submissions well in advance.

1. **Step 1:** Visit the FoSCoS portal at foscos.fssai.gov.in
2. **Step 2:** Log in using your existing FSSAI credentials and **FSSAI 14-digit license number**
3. **Step 3:** Navigate to the renewal section and select the appropriate license category
4. **Step 4:** Fill in the **FSSAI renewal form** with updated business details
5. **Step 5:** Upload all mandatory documents in the prescribed format
6. **Step 6:** Pay the applicable **FSSAI renewal fees** online through the portal
7. **Step 7:** Submit the application and save the acknowledgement number
8. **Step 8:** Track your **FSSAI renewal status** online using the reference number
9. **Step 9:** Receive the renewed FSSAI registration certificate via email upon approval

## What Are the FSSAI Renewal Fees in India?

The **FSSAI license renewal fees** vary based on the type of license, the validity period chosen, and the nature of the food business. Understanding the fee structure helps food businesses budget accurately and avoid last-minute financial surprises during the renewal process.

For a complete breakdown of applicable fee slabs, refer to the [FSSAI renewal fees essential guide](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-renewal/understanding-renewal-fees-an-essential-guide). Businesses that delay renewal beyond the expiry date will be liable to pay an additional **food license late renewal fee** of Rs. 100 per day.

| License Type | Renewal Fee (Per Year) | Late Fee |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Registration | Rs. 100 | Rs. 100/day |
| State License | Rs. 2,000 – Rs. 5,000 | Rs. 100/day |
| Central License | Rs. 7,500 | Rs. 100/day |

## How to Avoid Penalties on FSSAI Late Renewal in India?

Avoiding penalties on FSSAI late renewal requires proactive planning and timely submission. The **[FSSAI renewal before expiry](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/new-policy-for-renewing-the-fssai-license-after-the-expiry-date)** [rule](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/new-policy-for-renewing-the-fssai-license-after-the-expiry-date) mandates that all food businesses initiate the renewal process at least 30 days before the certificate's expiry date to avoid late fees and regulatory complications.

The **FSSAI renewal eligibility** covers all entities engaged in food manufacturing, processing, storage, distribution, transportation, and retail. all_sections.heading: What Documents Are Required for FSSAI Renewal in India?

Keeping your documents ready before initiating the renewal saves time and prevents application delays. all_sections.heading: How Does the FSSAI Renewal Process Work Online in India?
all_sections.content:
The step-by-step FSSAI renewal process on FoSCoS portal India is straightforward when completed with the correct information and documents. All renewals are processed digitally through the Food Safety Compliance System (FoSCoS) managed by FSSAI. Understanding the [duration for FSSAI renewal](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-renewal/understanding-the-duration-for-fssai-renewal) helps businesses plan submissions well in advance.

3. **Step 3:** Navigate to the renewal section and select the appropriate license category
4. **Step 4:** Fill in the **FSSAI renewal form** with updated business details
5. **Step 5:** Upload all mandatory documents in the prescribed format
6. **Step 6:** Pay the applicable **FSSAI renewal fees** online through the portal
7. **Step 7:** Submit the application and save the acknowledgement number
8. **Step 8:** Track your **FSSAI renewal status** online using the reference number
9. **Step 9:** Receive the renewed FSSAI registration certificate via email upon approval

# Digital Signature Certificate Registration Online in India

A **digital signature certificate** is a legally recognised electronic credential that authenticates the identity of individuals and organisations in India. Whether you are filing [income tax returns](https://www.indiafilings.com/income-tax-filing), submitting [MCA](https://www.indiafilings.com/mca-services) documents, or participating in e-tendering, [DSC registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/digital-signature) is your first step toward secure and paperless transactions. Get your DSC hassle-free with IndiaFilings today.

## What is a Digital Signature Certificate in India?

A **[Digital Signature Certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/basics-digital-signature) (DSC)** is an electronic form of a physical signature, issued by a licensed **Certifying Authority (CA)** in India. It uses **Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)** technology to verify the authenticity and integrity of digital documents. Under the **Information Technology Act, 2000**, a DSC holds the same legal validity as a handwritten signature. It is widely used for e-filing, online transactions, and government portal submissions across India.

## What Are the Types of Digital Signature Certificates Available in India?

Understanding the right type of **DSC certificate** for your needs is essential before initiating the **DSC registration online** process in India.

### Class 1 DSC

Class 1 DSC is issued to individuals for personal use. It verifies the user's name and email address. It is suitable for securing personal email communications and is the most basic level of **digital certificate online** verification in India.

### Class 2 DSC

Class 2 DSC was previously used for filing documents with the **Registrar of Companies (ROC)**, Income Tax Department, and other regulatory bodies. However, as per updated CCA guidelines, Class 2 DSC has been discontinued and replaced by Class 3 DSC.

### Class 3 DSC

**Class 3 DSC registration** is the highest level of digital signature, required for e-tendering, e-procurement, **DSC for GST filing**, MCA filings, customs, and more. It requires in-person verification and offers the strongest level of **electronic signature certificate** security in India.

## What Are the Benefits of Digital Signature Certificate in India?

The **benefits of digital signature certificate in India** go far beyond paperless signing. Here are the key advantages:

### Security Benefits

- Uses **public key infrastructure** to encrypt and protect data
- Prevents unauthorised access, forgery, and tampering of documents
- Ensures **non-repudiation** — the signer cannot deny having signed
- Provides end-to-end encrypted **online digital signature** verification

### Legal and Compliance Benefits

- Legally valid under the **IT Act 2000** and accepted by all Indian government portals
- Mandatory for **DSC for MCA filing**, Income Tax e-filing, GST registration, and customs
- Accepted for [company and business registrations](https://www.indiafilings.com/registrations) across India
- Reduces turnaround time for regulatory compliance

### Business Benefits

- Eliminates physical paperwork and courier delays
- Saves time and cost in document submission processes
- Enables participation in **DSC for e-tender** and government procurement portals
- Speeds up **digital signature for company** operations and filings

## What Are the Features of Digital Signature Certificate in India?

The **[features of digital signature certificate in India](https://www.indiafilings.com/digital-signature/understanding-the-feature-of-digital-signature)** make it a powerful tool for secure digital transactions and compliance.

### Authentication

A **DSC application form** linked to your identity ensures only authorised individuals can sign documents. The **digital signature token (USB token)** stores your certificate securely and requires a PIN for access, making authentication highly reliable.

### Data Integrity

Once a document is signed using a **digital certificate online**, any modification to the document invalidates the signature. This guarantees the integrity of contracts, agreements, and government submissions throughout the **DSC registration process India**.

### Non-Repudiation

The **electronic signature certificate** ensures that once a document is signed digitally, the signatory cannot deny its authenticity. This is critical for legal and financial documents, making DSC indispensable for **DSC for e-filing** and compliance in India.

### Portability

A DSC stored on a **USB token digital signature** device is portable and can be used on any computer. This makes the **apply for digital signature** process convenient for professionals, directors, and business owners across India.

## Who Issues the Digital Signature Certificate in India?

Understanding who issues the DSC helps you choose the right authority for your **DSC registration online** in India.

### Role of Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA)

The **Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA)**, under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), is the apex authority regulating all **Certifying Authorities in India**. The CCA licenses and oversees CAs to ensure the integrity and trustworthiness of the **digital signature certificate India** ecosystem.

### Licensed Certifying Authorities in India

Only government-licensed CAs can issue a valid **e-signature India**. The following are the prominent licensed CAs in India:

| NSDL e-Governance | Class 3 DSC | Income Tax, MCA, GST |
| Sify Technologies | Class 3 DSC | e-Tendering, e-Procurement |
| CDAC | Class 3 DSC | Government & PSU Officials |
| Capricorn CA | Class 3 DSC | Individuals, Directors, Customs |

## What Are the Documents Required for DSC Registration in India?

Gathering the right documents beforehand ensures a smooth **digital signature certificate registration** process. Refer to our detailed [document checklist for DSC](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/document-required-for-digital-signature) for a complete list.

### Documents for Individual Applicants

- **Identity Proof:** Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, or Voter ID
- **Address Proof:** Aadhaar Card, Utility Bill, Bank Statement (not older than 3 months)
- **Photograph:** Recent passport-size photograph
- **Mobile Number & Email ID:** Linked to Aadhaar for OTP-based verification

### Documents for Organisation or Company

- **Authorisation Letter** on company letterhead
- **Director/Signatory's Identity & Address Proof**
- **GST Registration Certificate** (if applicable)
- **Board Resolution** authorising the DSC applicant

The process to **obtain digital signature certificate in India** is straightforward when done through a trusted provider. Here is a step-by-step breakdown:

### Eligibility Criteria

- Any individual, company, [LLP](https://www.indiafilings.com/llp-registration), or organisation can **apply for digital signature** in India

2. **Fill the DSC Application Form** — Submit personal and organisational details via [the DSC application portal](https://www.indiafilings.com/digital-signature/digital-signature-application-guide)

### Verification and Issuance

- Upon approval, your **DSC certificate download** link or USB token is dispatched
- The **digital signature validity** is typically 1 or 2 years from the date of issuance

## How to Download Digital Signature Certificate Online in India?

Once your DSC is approved, you can download it easily. Follow these steps to complete your **DSC software download** and installation.

1. Visit the official portal of your **Certifying Authority India** (e.g., eMudhra, NSDL)

## Frequently asked questions

Common questions aboutDigital Signature Certificate Registration Online in India.

What is a Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)?

A DSC is an electronic credential issued by a Certifying Authority that verifies the identity of the certificate holder and enables legally valid digital signatures on electronic documents.

Why do I need a DSC?

DSCs are required to securely sign documents electronically, ensuring authenticity, data integrity, and legal validity, especially for government filings, tax returns, e-tendering, and other official digital transactions.

Who issues Digital Signature Certificates in India?

Licensed Certifying Authorities (CAs), regulated by the Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA) under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), issue DSCs in India.

What are the types of DSCs available?

- **Sign DSC**: For signing documents
- **Encrypt DSC**: For encrypting data
- **Sign & Encrypt DSC**: Combines both signing and encryption

What are the classes of Digital Signature Certificates?

- **Class 1**: For personal use, basic identity verification
- **Class 2**: Discontinued as of 2021
- **Class 3**: Highest security level, used for e-tendering, government filings, and legal documents

How long is a DSC valid?

A DSC is typically valid for 1 to 3 years. After expiry, it must be renewed.

How can I apply for a DSC?

You can apply online through a licensed Certifying Authority’s website by submitting identity documents, filling an application form, and completing the verification process.

What documents are required to apply for a DSC?

Generally, you need a PAN card, Aadhaar card, passport-sized photograph, and address proof such as a utility bill or passport.

Can a company apply for a DSC?

Yes, companies can apply for DSCs for their authorized signatories to conduct digital transactions and filings.

How is the identity of the applicant verified?

Identity is verified either through Aadhaar-based e-KYC or by submitting physical documents for manual verification at the Certifying Authority’s office or through an authorized attestation officer.

What is the difference between a DSC and an electronic signature?

A DSC uses encryption technology for secure and legally valid digital signatures, whereas an electronic signature can be a simple scanned image or typed name without encryption or legal validity.

Can a DSC be used for filing Income Tax Returns?

Yes, DSCs are mandatory for certain taxpayers to file income tax returns securely and authenticate their submissions.

Is DSC mandatory for GST filing?

For companies and LLPs, DSC is mandatory for GST registration and filing returns.

How do I renew my DSC?

DSC renewal requires re-verification of your identity and can be done online through the Certifying Authority’s portal, similar to the initial application process.

What happens if my DSC is lost or stolen?

If your DSC token is lost or stolen, inform the Certifying Authority immediately to revoke the certificate and prevent misuse. You will need to apply for a new DSC.

all_sections.heading: What is a Digital Signature Certificate in India?
all_sections.content: A **[Digital Signature Certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/basics-digital-signature) (DSC)** is an electronic form of a physical signature, issued by a licensed **Certifying Authority (CA)** in India. It uses **Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)** technology to verify the authenticity and integrity of digital documents. Under the **Information Technology Act, 2000**, a DSC holds the same legal validity as a handwritten signature. It is widely used for e-filing, online transactions, and government portal submissions across India.

all_sections.heading: What Are the Types of Digital Signature Certificates Available in India?
all_sections.content: Understanding the right type of **DSC certificate** for your needs is essential before initiating the **DSC registration online** process in India.

all_sections.heading: Class 1 DSC
all_sections.content: Class 1 DSC is issued to individuals for personal use. It verifies the user's name and email address. It is suitable for securing personal email communications and is the most basic level of **digital certificate online** verification in India.

all_sections.heading: Class 2 DSC
all_sections.content: Class 2 DSC was previously used for filing documents with the **Registrar of Companies (ROC)**, Income Tax Department, and other regulatory bodies. However, as per updated CCA guidelines, Class 2 DSC has been discontinued and replaced by Class 3 DSC.

all_sections.heading: Class 3 DSC
all_sections.content: **Class 3 DSC registration** is the highest level of digital signature, required for e-tendering, e-procurement, **DSC for GST filing**, MCA filings, customs, and more. It requires in-person verification and offers the strongest level of **electronic signature certificate** security in India.

all_sections.heading: Security Benefits

- Uses **public key infrastructure** to encrypt and protect data
- Prevents unauthorised access, forgery, and tampering of documents
- Ensures **non-repudiation** — the signer cannot deny having signed
- Provides end-to-end encrypted **online digital signature** verification

all_sections.heading: What Are the Features of Digital Signature Certificate in India?
all_sections.content: The **[features of digital signature certificate in India](https://www.indiafilings.com/digital-signature/understanding-the-feature-of-digital-signature)** make it a powerful tool for secure digital transactions and compliance.

all_sections.heading: Authentication
all_sections.content: A **DSC application form** linked to your identity ensures only authorised individuals can sign documents. The **digital signature token (USB token)** stores your certificate securely and requires a PIN for access, making authentication highly reliable.

all_sections.heading: Data Integrity
all_sections.content: Once a document is signed using a **digital certificate online**, any modification to the document invalidates the signature. This guarantees the integrity of contracts, agreements, and government submissions throughout the **DSC registration process India**.

all_sections.heading: Non-Repudiation
all_sections.content: The **electronic signature certificate** ensures that once a document is signed digitally, the signatory cannot deny its authenticity. This is critical for legal and financial documents, making DSC indispensable for **DSC for e-filing** and compliance in India.

all_sections.heading: Portability
all_sections.content: A DSC stored on a **USB token digital signature** device is portable and can be used on any computer. This makes the **apply for digital signature** process convenient for professionals, directors, and business owners across India.

all_sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
all_sections.content:
Common questions aboutDigital Signature Certificate Registration Online in India.

What is a Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)?

A DSC is an electronic credential issued by a Certifying Authority that verifies the identity of the certificate holder and enables legally valid digital signatures on electronic documents.

Why do I need a DSC?

DSCs are required to securely sign documents electronically, ensuring authenticity, data integrity, and legal validity, especially for government filings, tax returns, e-tendering, and other official digital transactions.

Who issues Digital Signature Certificates in India?

Licensed Certifying Authorities (CAs), regulated by the Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA) under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), issue DSCs in India.

What are the types of DSCs available?

- **Sign DSC**: For signing documents
- **Encrypt DSC**: For encrypting data
- **Sign & Encrypt DSC**: Combines both signing and encryption

What are the classes of Digital Signature Certificates?

- **Class 1**: For personal use, basic identity verification
- **Class 2**: Discontinued as of 2021
- **Class 3**: Highest security level, used for e-tendering, government filings, and legal documents

How long is a DSC valid?

A DSC is typically valid for 1 to 3 years. After expiry, it must be renewed.

How can I apply for a DSC?

You can apply online through a licensed Certifying Authority’s website by submitting identity documents, filling an application form, and completing the verification process.

What documents are required to apply for a DSC?

Generally, you need a PAN card, Aadhaar card, passport-sized photograph, and address proof such as a utility bill or passport.

Can a company apply for a DSC?

Yes, companies can apply for DSCs for their authorized signatories to conduct digital transactions and filings.

How is the identity of the applicant verified?

Identity is verified either through Aadhaar-based e-KYC or by submitting physical documents for manual verification at the Certifying Authority’s office or through an authorized attestation officer.

What is the difference between a DSC and an electronic signature?

A DSC uses encryption technology for secure and legally valid digital signatures, whereas an electronic signature can be a simple scanned image or typed name without encryption or legal validity.

Can a DSC be used for filing Income Tax Returns?

Yes, DSCs are mandatory for certain taxpayers to file income tax returns securely and authenticate their submissions.

Is DSC mandatory for GST filing?

For companies and LLPs, DSC is mandatory for GST registration and filing returns.

How do I renew my DSC?

DSC renewal requires re-verification of your identity and can be done online through the Certifying Authority’s portal, similar to the initial application process.

What happens if my DSC is lost or stolen?

If your DSC token is lost or stolen, inform the Certifying Authority immediately to revoke the certificate and prevent misuse. You will need to apply for a new DSC.

all_sections.content:
Common questions abouteMudhra Digital Signature Certificate Online India.

What is a Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)?

A Digital Signature Certificate is a secure digital key that authenticates the identity of the holder and is used to sign digital documents and transactions securely.

Who issues the Digital Signature Certificate in India?

DSCs are issued by licensed Certifying Authorities (CAs) like eMudhra, which is authorized by the Controller of Certifying Authorities (CCA) under the Indian IT Act.

Why is a Digital Signature Certificate important?

It ensures authenticity, data integrity, and legal validity for online transactions, eliminating the need for physical signatures.

What is an eMudhra DSC?

eMudhra DSC is a digital certificate issued by eMudhra CA, used for securely signing documents and conducting authenticated digital transactions.

Who needs a DSC?

Individuals, businesses, directors, company secretaries, and professionals involved in activities like tax filing, company registration, e-tendering, or foreign trade.

What are the types of DSCs available through eMudhra?

eMudhra offers Class 2, Class 3, and DGFT DSCs, each tailored for specific use cases like tax filing, e-tendering, or import-export.

What is a Class 3 DSC?

Class 3 DSC provides the highest level of security and is mandatory for e-tendering, e-auctions, and other high-risk online activities.

How long is a DSC valid?

You can choose between 1-year, 2-year, or 3-year validity options depending on your needs.

Can I use the same DSC for multiple purposes?

Yes, depending on the type (Signature or Signature & Encryption), it can be used across various platforms like MCA, GST, Income Tax, and DGFT.

What is a DGFT DSC?

A DGFT DSC is used by businesses that hold an Importer Exporter Code (IEC) to securely transact with the Directorate General of Foreign Trade.

What documents are needed to apply for a DSC?

Generally required:

- PAN Card
- Proof of Address (Utility bill, Voter ID, etc.)
- Passport-size photograph
- Identity verification documents

Can the DSC application be done online?

Yes, the complete process—from filling the application to identity verification and downloading the DSC—is done online via IndiaFilings.

Is physical verification required to get a DSC?

No. eMudhra and IndiaFilings support paperless online verification, including Aadhaar-based eKYC or video verification.

What is a USB token, and is it required?

A USB token is a secure hardware device (FIPS-compliant) where your DSC is stored. It is mandatory for Class 3 DSCs to prevent unauthorized use.

Can I renew my expired DSC?

Yes. Renewal requires fresh identity verification as per CCA guidelines and follows the same process as a new application.

What happens if my DSC expires?

Once expired, the DSC becomes invalid. You must renew or apply for a new DSC to continue using it for digital transactions.

How long does it take to get a DSC?

Typically, it takes 1 to 3 working days to issue a DSC after successful verification and document submission.

Can I use a DSC for GST, MCA, and Income Tax filings?

Yes. A valid DSC (usually Class 2 or Class 3) can be used for all major government portals.

Is an eMudhra DSC legally valid in India?

Absolutely. eMudhra is licensed by the CCA, and all DSCs issued are legally valid under the Indian IT Act, 2000.

How can IndiaFilings help me get a DSC?

IndiaFilings provides a completely online and simplified process to apply for eMudhra DSCs, including document assistance, identity verification, and issuing of secure USB tokens.

# FSSAI Return Filing Online in India

**FSSAI return filing online in India** is a mandatory compliance requirement for every food business operator holding a valid FSSAI licence. The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) mandates that licensed food businesses submit periodic returns detailing their food production, procurement, import, and sales data. Filing these returns on time ensures your business remains compliant with **food safety compliance India** norms and avoids hefty penalties.

Whether you are a manufacturer, importer, distributor, or retailer, understanding the [**FSSAI return filing process**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-return-filing/fssai-return-filing-guide-essential-insights) is critical to maintaining your food licence in good standing. Timely and accurate return filing reflects your commitment to food safety standards and keeps your business legally protected.

## What is FSSAI Return Filing for Food Businesses in India?

FSSAI return filing is the process by which food business operators submit periodic compliance reports to the FSSAI through the official FoSCoS portal. These returns capture details about the type, quantity, and source of food products handled during a specific period. Every licenced food business in India is legally obligated to file these returns within the prescribed deadlines.

The **FSSAI annual return** and periodic returns are governed under the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011. Two primary forms are used for this purpose:

- **Form D1:** Annual return applicable to manufacturers, importers, and certain other category food businesses.
- **Form D2:** Half-yearly return applicable to dairy units and milk chilling units.

Understanding the difference between these forms is essential. Refer to the [**FSSAI annual return filing**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-return-filing/fssai-return-filing-guide-annual-filing-explained) details to determine which form applies to your business category.

### Types of FSSAI Returns in India

- **Annual Return (Form D1):** Filed by manufacturers and importers before 31st May every year for the previous financial year.
- **Half-Yearly Return (Form D2):** Filed by dairy and milk chilling units twice a year — before 31st October and 30th April.

## Who Needs to File FSSAI Returns in India?

Not every food business operator is required to file FSSAI returns. The obligation depends on the type of licence held and the category of food business operations conducted. Understanding who is required to comply helps businesses avoid unnecessary penalties and non-compliance notices.

The following categories of **food business operators** are mandatorily required to file FSSAI returns:

- Food manufacturers holding a Central or State FSSAI licence
- Food importers registered with FSSAI
- Dairy units and milk chilling centres
- Cold storage facilities handling food products
- Wholesale distributors of food products
- Relabellers and repackers of food items

Businesses that hold only a basic FSSAI registration (with turnover below ₹12 lakhs) are generally exempt from filing periodic returns. However, those holding a State or Central licence must comply with the **FSSAI compliance filing** requirements mandatorily. Learn more about licence categories from the [**food safety licence return**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-license/fssai-registration-vs-license-key-differences-explained) requirements explained in detail.

### Key Criteria for FSSAI Return Filing Applicability

- Type of FSSAI licence held (Central or State)
- Nature of food business operations
- Annual turnover and scale of operations
- Category of food products handled

## What is the Due Date for FSSAI Return Filing in India?

Missing the FSSAI return filing deadline can attract significant penalties and may even lead to licence suspension. The **FSSAI return filing due date** is fixed by the regulatory authority and must be strictly adhered to by all applicable food business operators across India.

| Return Type | Applicable To | Due Date | Period Covered |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Form D1 (Annual Return) | Manufacturers, Importers | 31st May every year | Previous Financial Year (April–March) |
| Form D2 (Half-Yearly Return) | Dairy Units, Milk Chilling Units | 31st October & 30th April | April–September & October–March |

It is highly recommended to initiate the **FSSAI online return submission** well before the deadline to avoid last-minute technical issues on the FoSCoS portal. The [**FSSAI compliance filing**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-return-filing/fssai-return-filing-simplifying-compliance) process involves multiple steps that require adequate preparation time.

## What Documents Are Required for FSSAI Return Filing in India?

Accurate documentation is the foundation of a successful FSSAI return filing. Food business operators must compile and verify the relevant records before initiating the filing process on the FoSCoS portal. Incomplete or incorrect data submissions can lead to rejection or compliance notices from the authority.

### Documents Required for FSSAI Return Filing

- Valid FSSAI licence certificate copy
- Details of food products manufactured, imported, or handled
- Quantity of food products produced or procured (in metric tonnes)
- Raw material procurement records
- Sales and distribution data for the filing period
- Import records and bills of entry (for importers)
- Milk procurement and processing data (for dairy units)
- FoSCoS portal login credentials

Maintaining well-organised records throughout the year significantly simplifies the **FSSAI return filing procedure** at the time of submission. Businesses can also refer to the [**food business annual return**](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/food-business-annual-return) details to understand exactly what data points need to be captured and reported.

## How Does the FSSAI Return Filing Process Work Online in India?

The entire **FSSAI return filing process** is conducted online through the Food Safety Compliance System (FoSCoS) portal. The portal has streamlined the submission process, making it accessible and manageable for food business operators across India. Following the correct sequence of steps ensures your return is submitted without errors or rejections.

### Steps to File FSSAI Return Online

1. **Login to FoSCoS Portal:** Visit the official FoSCoS portal and log in using your FSSAI licence credentials.
2. **Navigate to Return Filing Section:** Go to the 'Compliance' section and select the relevant return form (Form D1 or Form D2).
3. **Fill in Business Details:** Enter your FSSAI licence number, business name, address, and contact details accurately.
4. **Enter Product Details:** Provide information about all food products manufactured, imported, or processed during the return period, including quantities in metric tonnes.
5. **Upload Supporting Documents:** Attach the required documents such as production records, import data, and raw material procurement details.
6. **Review and Verify:** Carefully review all the entered data for accuracy before proceeding to submission.
7. **Submit the Return:** Submit the completed form on the FoSCoS portal and download the acknowledgement receipt for your records.

Food business operators who find the online process complex can benefit from professional assistance to ensure accurate and timely [**FSSAI online return submission**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-return-filing/apply-fssai-return-filing-online-easily). Expert support reduces the risk of errors and ensures full regulatory compliance.

## What is the Penalty for Late FSSAI Return Filing in India?

The FSSAI imposes strict financial penalties on food business operators who fail to file their returns within the prescribed due dates. Non-compliance with **FSSAI return filing last date** requirements can result in escalating penalties and even licence cancellation in severe cases.

- **Late Filing Penalty:** ₹100 per day for every day of delay beyond the due date.
- **Non-Filing Penalty:** Failure to file returns can attract penalties under Section 55 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, which may extend up to ₹2 lakh.
- **Licence Suspension:** Persistent non-compliance may lead to suspension or cancellation of the FSSAI licence.

To avoid these penalties, food businesses must maintain a proactive compliance calendar and ensure the **FSSAI Form D1 filing** is completed well within the stipulated deadline. Understanding the [**FSSAI return filing for manufacturers**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-return-filing/optimize-fssai-return-filing-for-businesses) requirements helps businesses plan their compliance activities effectively.

### Consequences of Non-Compliance

- Daily monetary penalty of ₹100 per day of delay
- Legal notices from FSSAI authorities
- Licence suspension or cancellation
- Reputational damage and loss of consumer trust
- Restrictions on business operations

## What is the Cost of FSSAI Return Filing in India?

The cost associated with **FSSAI return filing fees** depends on whether the business chooses to file independently or engages professional assistance. While the government portal itself does not charge a fee for filing returns, the overall compliance cost includes documentation, professional fees, and time investment.

Explore how the [**FSSAI compliance return filing**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai/fssai-cost-pricing-validity-tenure-guide) costs are structured for different categories of food businesses.

## How Does FSSAI Return Filing Relate to FSSAI Licence and Renewal in India?

FSSAI return filing is closely linked to your overall **food licence annual return** compliance status and directly impacts your licence renewal eligibility. FSSAI authorities consider the return filing history of a food business operator when processing licence renewal applications. Businesses with a consistent and clean filing record experience smoother and faster renewals.

Food business operators must ensure that all pending returns are filed and cleared before applying for [**FSSAI licence renewal**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-renewal/fssai-license-renewal-process-in-india). Any outstanding defaults in return filing may delay or even result in rejection of the renewal application by the FSSAI authority.

Similarly, understanding the difference between [**FSSAI licence requirements**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-license/understand-the-fssai-license-requirements) and basic registration helps food businesses determine their exact compliance obligations, including whether they are required to file periodic returns.

### FSSAI Return Filing and Licence Renewal — Key Connection

- Pending returns can block licence renewal applications
- Consistent filing history builds regulatory credibility
- All returns must be up to date before renewal submission
- FoSCoS portal tracks filing history linked to your licence number

process_sections.heading: FSSAI Return Filing Online in India
process_sections.content:
**FSSAI return filing online in India** is a mandatory compliance requirement for every food business operator holding a valid FSSAI licence. The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) mandates that licensed food businesses submit periodic returns detailing their food production, procurement, import, and sales data. Filing these returns on time ensures your business remains compliant with **food safety compliance India** norms and avoids hefty penalties.

Whether you are a manufacturer, importer, distributor, or retailer, understanding the [**FSSAI return filing process**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-return-filing/fssai-return-filing-guide-essential-insights) is critical to maintaining your food licence in good standing. Timely and accurate return filing reflects your commitment to food safety standards and keeps your business legally protected.

process_sections.heading: What is FSSAI Return Filing for Food Businesses in India?
process_sections.content:
FSSAI return filing is the process by which food business operators submit periodic compliance reports to the FSSAI through the official FoSCoS portal. These returns capture details about the type, quantity, and source of food products handled during a specific period. Every licenced food business in India is legally obligated to file these returns within the prescribed deadlines.

The **FSSAI annual return** and periodic returns are governed under the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011. Two primary forms are used for this purpose:

- **Form D1:** Annual return applicable to manufacturers, importers, and certain other category food businesses.
- **Form D2:** Half-yearly return applicable to dairy units and milk chilling units.

Understanding the difference between these forms is essential. Refer to the [**FSSAI annual return filing**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-return-filing/fssai-return-filing-guide-annual-filing-explained) details to determine which form applies to your business category.

process_sections.heading: Who Needs to File FSSAI Returns in India?
process_sections.content:
Not every food business operator is required to file FSSAI returns. The obligation depends on the type of licence held and the category of food business operations conducted. Understanding who is required to comply helps businesses avoid unnecessary penalties and non-compliance notices.

The following categories of **food business operators** are mandatorily required to file FSSAI returns:

- Food manufacturers holding a Central or State FSSAI licence
- Food importers registered with FSSAI
- Dairy units and milk chilling centres
- Cold storage facilities handling food products
- Wholesale distributors of food products
- Relabellers and repackers of food items

Businesses that hold only a basic FSSAI registration (with turnover below ₹12 lakhs) are generally exempt from filing periodic returns. However, those holding a State or Central licence must comply with the **FSSAI compliance filing** requirements mandatorily. Learn more about licence categories from the [**food safety licence return**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-license/fssai-registration-vs-license-key-differences-explained) requirements explained in detail.

process_sections.heading: Key Criteria for FSSAI Return Filing Applicability
process_sections.content:
- Type of FSSAI licence held (Central or State)
- Nature of food business operations
- Annual turnover and scale of operations
- Category of food products handled

process_sections.heading: What is the Due Date for FSSAI Return Filing in India?
process_sections.content:
Missing the FSSAI return filing deadline can attract significant penalties and may even lead to licence suspension. The **FSSAI return filing due date** is fixed by the regulatory authority and must be strictly adhered to by all applicable food business operators across India.

| Return Type | Applicable To | Due Date | Period Covered |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Form D1 (Annual Return) | Manufacturers, Importers | 31st May every year | Previous Financial Year (April–March) |
| Form D2 (Half-Yearly Return) | Dairy Units, Milk Chilling Units | 31st October & 30th April | April–September & October–March |

It is highly recommended to initiate the **FSSAI online return submission** well before the deadline to avoid last-minute technical issues on the FoSCoS portal. The [**FSSAI compliance filing**](https://www.indiafilings.com/fssai-return-filing/fssai-return-filing-simplifying-compliance) process involves multiple steps that require adequate preparation time.

process_sections.heading: Steps to File FSSAI Return Online
process_sections.content:
1. **Login to FoSCoS Portal:** Visit the official FoSCoS portal and log in using your FSSAI licence credentials.
2. **Navigate to Return Filing Section:** Go to the 'Compliance' section and select the relevant return form (Form D1 or Form D2).
3. **Fill in Business Details:** Enter your FSSAI licence number, business name, address, and contact details accurately.
4. **Enter Product Details:** Provide information about all food products manufactured, imported, or processed during the return period, including quantities in metric tonnes.
5. **Upload Supporting Documents:** Attach the required documents such as production records, import data, and raw material procurement details.
6. **Review and Verify:** Carefully review all the entered data for accuracy before proceeding to submission.
