content_sections.heading: Aadhaar Data Update
content_sections.content:
An Aadhaar Data Update form can be used when an Indian resident wants to update any of the details in his/her Aadhaar card. The details captured on the Aadhaar card of every resident are recorded in the UIDAI system.

It is necessary for the Aadhaar cardholders to keep their details updated whenever there are biometric or demographic changes as they get saved in the Central Identities Data Repository (CIDR). In this article, we look at the process for updating Aadhar card details.

To know more about

[Linking Aadhaar with UAN - EPFO](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/linking-aadhaar-with-uan-epfo)

content_sections.heading: Aadhaar Card Details Update
content_sections.content:
The UIDAI (Unique Identification Authority of India) enables the Aadhaar card holders to correct or update their demographic details on the authority’s database. The biometric data can only be updated at an enrolment centre.

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Demographic information** | **Biometric information** |
| Name, Address, Date of Birth/Age, e-mail Address, Gender, Mobile Number, Relationship Status and Information Sharing Consent. | Iris, Finger Prints and Facial Photograph. |

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.content:
The following documents are accepted by the UIDAI for the purpose of verifying, updating or correcting information in the Aadhaar Card.

- **Proof of Identification:-** An identity documents that includes Ration/PDS Photo Card, PAN Card, Passport, Driving license, etc.
- **Proof of Address:-** The address proof documents that include Bank Account details/Passbook, Electricity bill, water bill and telephone, Property Tax receipt, Credit Card statement, etc.
- **Proof of Date of Birth:-** The documents accepted for the proof of identity that includes Birth Certificate, Mark sheet issued by any Government Board or University, PAN card, etc.

content_sections.heading: Aadhar Data Update Charges
content_sections.content: Method of updating or correcting Aadhar details through online and via post can be done free of cost. If done at the enrollment centre for the correction/update, the applicant will be charged a fee of Rs. 25/-.

content_sections.heading: Turnaround Time
content_sections.content: The processing time for the updates or corrections in the Aadhar card will take 7-10 days after the request.

content_sections.heading: Methods for Updating Aadhaar Card Details
content_sections.content:
The residents can update or correct their Aadhar card details via 3 modes:

1. Update Data Online
2. Update Data via Post
3. Visiting nearby Enrolment Centre

These are the modes where residents place their demographic/biometric update request.

content_sections.heading: Update Data Online
content_sections.content: The applicants have to follow the given steps to update or make corrections to the Aadhar card by submitting their request online.

content_sections.heading: Access Self Service Update Portal (SSUP)
content_sections.content:
**Step 1:**

Applicants has to visit the official site of Aadhar Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) to update or correct their Aadhar details from the portal.

![Content image](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/aa-1-2.jpg)

Step 1 - Aadhaar Data Update

content_sections.heading: Login to the portal
content_sections.content:
**Step 2:**

Using Aadhaar number or registered mobile number of the resident are required to log in to the portal. After that, enter the Text Verification and click on the "Send OTP" option.

![Content image](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/aa-2.jpg)

Step 2 - Aadhaar Data Update

**Step 3:**

Enter the OTP with the Captcha code and click on “Submit” option.

content_sections.heading: Aadhar Data Update Request
content_sections.content:
**Step 4:**

After submitting, it will get directed to a new page which is “Data Request Page”. Now you need to select the field where the changes must be done.

![Content image](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/aa-3.jpg)

Step 4 - Aadhar Data Update

content_sections.heading: Upload Requested Documents
content_sections.content:
**Step 5:**

Then you have to attach the specified documents in the portal. Ensure to scan (with a colour scanner) and upload the proof of the changed details that has been updated.

**Step 6:**

The documents will be verified against the requested data by a Verifier of UIDAI’s Update back-office.

content_sections.heading: Provide Details
content_sections.content:
**Step 7:**

Then you have to fill out the data in the selected fields.

**Step 8:**

After filling the details and double check on the accuracy of the information as it will get reflected in the new Aadhaar card.

content_sections.heading: Download Update Request Number (URN) receipt
content_sections.content:
**Step 9:**

A URN (Update Request Number) will be generated through which the Aadhaar card update process can be tracked or verified by the applicant.

![Content image](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/aa-5.jpg)

Step 9 - Aadhaar Data Update

**Step 10:**

You can drop the receipt or download a copy containing the URN. Once updated, you can download the updated Aadhar card and print it. The updated Aadhaar card will be mailed to the registered address.

content_sections.heading: Updating Aadhar Details via Post
content_sections.content: The applicants can also send a request via post to update or make corrections in their Aadhar card. The applicant has to follow the given steps to complete the process.

content_sections.heading: Download Application Form
content_sections.content:
**Step 1:**

You have to download the application form for the Aadhar data correction/update process.

The application form is reproduced below for your ready references:

_**[Open PDF in new tab](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/Aadhaar-Data-Update-Form-03-1.pdf)**_

_**[Open PDF in new tab](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/Aadhaar-Data-Update-Form-03-1.pdf)**_

content_sections.heading: Fill the Required Details
content_sections.content:
**Step 2:**

You have to fill the required details which you want to change in your Aadhaar card.

content_sections.heading: Attach Documents
content_sections.content:
**Step 3:**

You will have to submit the photocopies of the documents that validate the changes requested to be made in the form.

content_sections.heading: Dispatch the Application
content_sections.content:
**Step 4:** Send the form along with the documents to any one of the postal address as mentioned below: | | | | --- | --- | | **Address 1** | **Address 2** | | UIDAI
Post Box No. 10, Chhindwara,
Madhya Pradesh – 480001,
India. | Post Box No. 99,
Banjara Hills,
Hyderabad – 500034,
India. |

content_sections.heading: Visiting Nearby Enrolment Centre
content_sections.content:
Aadhaar Enrolment centres that enrol the applicants for Aadhaar after taking their biometric and demographic details following the UIDAI enrolment process. Aadhaar Enrolment Centres in other cities can be found on Aadhaar Enrolment Centres link, which will take you to the below-displayed screen:

The Aadhar card holders can update their details by visiting the nearest Enrolment Centre by following the steps specified below:

![Content image](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/aa-23.jpg)

Enrollment centre - Aadhaar Data Update

content_sections.heading: Get Application Form
content_sections.content:
**Step 1:**

Aadhaar data update form has to be filled by the applicant.

**Step 2:**

Ensure to give the correct details in the application form.

content_sections.heading: Provide self-attested proofs
content_sections.content:
**Step 3:**

You have to provide the self-attested proofs to support the changes as per your request.

**Step 4:**

After that, submit the form and the relevant document proofs to the Executive in the centre.

content_sections.heading: End of Process
content_sections.content:
**Step 5:**

The Enrolment Centres will charge Rs. 25/- for every such visit towards the correction of details like biometric data or Demographic information such as mobile numbers, address, photo etc.

**Note:**

Children those who are of 5 years old must visit the Aadhaar enrolment centre to submit their biometric data. After 15 years of age, they must revisit an enrolment centre to provide their biometric data. This biometric data is considered as the final one which remains with your Aadhaar for a lifetime.

content_sections.heading: Track/Check Application Status
content_sections.content:
You can also track/verify your application status online via Self Service Update Portal (SSUP). Provide your Aadhar number; URN number received SRN number along with the text verification. Then you have to click on the get status button. The status of your Aadhar data update will be displayed on the screen.

![Content image](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/status-aa.jpg)

Application Status - Aadhaar Data Update

content_sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
content_sections.content:
Common questions aboutAadhaar Data Update.

What documents are required to update Aadhaar card details?

According to the article, the following documents are accepted by the UIDAI for the purpose of verifying, updating or correcting information in the Aadhaar Card: Proof of Identification (Ration/PDS Photo Card, PAN Card, Passport, Driving license, etc.), Proof of Address (Bank Account details/Passbook, Electricity bill, water bill and telephone, Property Tax receipt, Credit Card statement, etc.), and Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate, Mark sheet issued by any Government Board or University, PAN card, etc.).

Is there a fee for updating Aadhaar card details online or through post?

No, the article states that the method of updating or correcting Aadhar details through online and via post can be done free of cost. However, if done at the enrollment centre for the correction/update, the applicant will be charged a fee of Rs. 25/-.

How long does it take for Aadhaar card details to be updated after submitting a request?

The article mentions that the processing time for the updates or corrections in the Aadhar card will take 7-10 days after the request is submitted.

Can biometric information like fingerprints and iris scans be updated online or by post?

No, the article clearly states that biometric information like iris, fingerprints, and facial photograph can only be updated at an enrolment centre. Demographic information such as name, address, date of birth, email address, gender, mobile number, etc., can be updated online or via post.

How can I track the status of my Aadhaar card update request?

You can track or verify your Aadhaar data update application status online via the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP). You need to provide your Aadhaar number, Update Request Number (URN) or SRN number received, and the text verification. After clicking the 'Get Status' button, the status of your update request will be displayed on the screen.

Can children below 5 years of age update their biometric information on the Aadhaar card?

No, the article mentions that children those who are of 5 years old must visit the Aadhaar enrolment centre to submit their biometric data. After 15 years of age, they must revisit an enrolment centre to provide their biometric data, which is considered as the final one for a lifetime.

What is the process for updating Aadhaar card details by visiting an enrolment centre?

To update Aadhaar card details at an enrolment centre, you need to fill out an application form, provide self-attested proofs to support the changes, and submit the form and documents to the executive at the centre. The enrolment centre will charge a fee of Rs. 25 for updating biometric data or demographic information like mobile numbers, address, photo, etc.

Can I update my Aadhaar card details if I have recently changed my marital status?

Yes, the article mentions that relationship status is one of the demographic details that can be updated on the Aadhaar card. You would need to provide the necessary proof documents for the change in marital status.

What is the purpose of updating Aadhaar card details?

It is necessary for Aadhaar cardholders to keep their details updated whenever there are biometric or demographic changes, as these details get saved in the Central Identities Data Repository (CIDR). Updating Aadhaar card details ensures that the information associated with an individual's Aadhaar card remains accurate and up-to-date.

Can I update my Aadhaar card details if I have changed my email address?

Yes, according to the article, email address is one of the demographic details that can be updated on the Aadhaar card. You would need to provide the necessary proof documents to verify your new email address.

blogs.title: MSME Udyam Registration - Get MSME's Udyam Registered Online

content_sections.heading: MSME Udyam Registration - Get MSME's Udyam Registered Online
content_sections.content: Udyam registration is the new process for registering MSME (micro, small and medium enterprises) launched by the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises on July 1, 2020. The Ministry had also revised the definition of MSMEs from the same date.  An enterprise for this process is known as Udyam, and its Registration Process is known as [Udyam Registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration). A permanent registration number will be issued after Registration.

content_sections.heading: Udyam Registration Vs. Udyog Aadhaar registration
content_sections.content: Udyam Registration or MSME Registration is nothing but a government registration that is provided along with a recognition certificate and a unique number. This registration is to certify micro/small/medium enterprises. The Udyog Aadhaar registration has been transformed to the Udyam registration since July 2020. Udyam registration has made the process more accessible than it was earlier, at the time of [Udyog Aadhaar registration.](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/udyog-aadhaar-for-msmes)Udyam registration is essential for availing the various benefits of schemes or programs of the Ministry of MSME, such as the Credit Guarantee Scheme, public procurement policy, additional edge in Government Tenders and protection against delayed payments, etc.

content_sections.heading: Udyam Registration Certificate
content_sections.content: After completion of the process of Udyam Registration, a certificate will be issued online. This Udyam Registration Certificate will have a dynamic QR Code from which the details about the enterprise can be accessed.

content_sections.heading: Renewal of Udyam Registration
content_sections.content: Udyam Registration Number is a permanent identification number, and there will be no need for renewal of Registration.

content_sections.heading: Udyam Registration Benefits
content_sections.content:
The Udayam Registration is a simple process and there is no need to handle the paperwork for obtaining Udyam Registration. Having Udyam Registration for your venture entitles your Business to the following benefits:

- Special Preference in Procuring Government Tender
- Udyam registration will help to get the bank loans without Collateral/ Mortgage. 1 percent Exemption on the interest rate on Bank Overdraft (OD)
- There are various tax rebates available for Udyam registered enterprises.
- Higher preference is provided to businesses registered under Udyam for government license and certification.
- Registered Udyam gets tariff subsidies and tax and capital subsidies
- Concession in Electricity Bills
- It gives protection against the delay in payment from Buyers
- Tax Rebates
- Special 50% discount on Government fees for Trademark and Patent filing
- Fast Resolution of Disputes

[For more details on MSME Registration Benefits in India, click here](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/msme-registration-benefits-in-india)

content_sections.heading: Who can apply for Udyam registration?
content_sections.content: Any person who aspires to establish a micro, small, or medium enterprise can avail of Udyam Registration.Proprietorships, Hindu Undivided Family (HUF), Partnership Firms, One Person Companies, Private Limited Companies, Limited Companies, Producer Companies, Limited Liability Partnerships, any association of persons, cooperative societies, or any other undertaking can obtain MSME Udyam Registration in India.

content_sections.heading: Revised MSME definition – The Atamnirbhar Bharat package
content_sections.content:
After 14 years since the MSME Development Act, a revision in the MSME definition was announced in the Atmnirbhar Bharat package on 13.05.2020 to bring more units under the purview of the schemes announced. According to this package, the composite criteria for the definition of MSME are investment and turnover; the limit has been revised upwards. The distinction between the service and the manufacturing sector has also been eliminated.

- The limit of the Micro units (both manufacturing and services) was increased to Rs. 1 Crore investment and Rs. 5 Crore turnover.
- Similarly, the limits of the small unit also increased to Rs. 10 Crore of investment and Rs 50 Crore of turnover.
- The limits of the medium enterprises were increased to Rs. 20 Crore of investment and Rs. 100 Crore turnover.

![MSME 02 01 4](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/MSME_02-01-4.png)

MSME Udyam Registration - Get MSME's Udyam Registered Online

For better understanding, go through the table attached here:

|     |     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Composite Criteria: Investment in Plant / Machinery and Turnover** |
| **Sl.No** | **Type of Enterprises** | **Investment** | **Turnover** |
| 1 | Micro enterprises | Less than Rs.1 Crore | Less than Rs.5 Crore |
| 2 | Small enterprises | Less than Rs.10 Crore | Less than Rs.50 Crore |
| 3 | Medium enterprises | Less than Rs.20 Crore | Less than Rs.100 Crore |

Know more about the Highlights of[**the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyaan Economic Package**](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/atmanirbhar-bharat-coronavirus-economic-stimulus-package)

content_sections.heading: MSME Notification July 2021: Addition of Retail and Wholesale Trade under MSME
content_sections.content: Earlier, the MSME registration covered only the manufacturing and service industries. However, in July 2021, the government announced that the wholesale and retail trade will come under the MSME classification and thus can apply for MSME registration of their wholesale/retail trade business except for motor vehicles and motorcycles. Thus, manufacturing and service industries and wholesale and retail trade are covered and eligible to apply for MSME registration. [Click here to know more about the Addition of Retail and Wholesale Trade under MSME](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/revised-definition-of-msme-addition-of-retail-and-wholesale-trade)

content_sections.heading: When to apply for MSME Udyam Registration registration?
content_sections.content: Obtaining Udyam Registration is not mandatory and is at the sole discretion of the Entrepreneur. However, it is recommended that most businesses obtain MSME registration right after Registration to enjoy various benefits offered by the Government.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Udyam Registration Online
content_sections.content: The Online Udyam Registration application process is based on self-declaration, and there is no further requirement to upload any documents.The applicant will only need to furnish their 12-digit Aadhaar Number, PAN, and Bank Account details of Business for the registration process.

content_sections.heading: Udyam registration of New Enterprise -  Udyam Registration Portal
content_sections.content:
The new enterprise is required to follow the below steps to register on Udyam Registration Portal:

- The new enterprise is willing to establish itself as an MSME and needs to apply for online Udyam Registration in Udyam Registration Portal.
- The application is based on self-declaration, and there is no further requirement to upload any documents, certificates, papers, or proofs. Udyam registration is free of cost.
-  An Aadhaar number is mandatory for obtaining Udyam Registration. Following Aadhaar number is required based on the type of firm

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Type of firm** | **The person whose Aadhaar number is required** |
| Proprietorship firm | Proprietor |
| Partnership firm | Managing partner |
| Hindu Undivided Family | Karta |
| Company or a Co-operative Society or a Trust or a Limited Liability Partnership | Authorized signatory |

- PAN and GST-linked details on investment and turnover of enterprises will be taken automatically from Government databases.
- MSME online system is fully integrated with Income Tax and GSTIN systems.
- On successful application submission, the enterprise will be assigned a 'Udyam Registration Number' (i.e., permanent identity number).
- On completion of the registration process, the enterprise shall be issued an 'Udyam Registration Certificate.'

Note:

Importantly, an enterprise can file only one Udyam Registration. Additionally, multiple numbers of enterprise activities, i.e., manufacturing, services, or both, can be added to one Udyam Registration.

content_sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
content_sections.content:
Common questions aboutMSME Udyam Registration.

What is Udyam Registration?

Udyam Registration is the new process introduced by the Government of India for registering Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs). It replaces the earlier Udyog Aadhaar registration process. After completing Udyam Registration, enterprises will be issued a permanent registration number and a recognition certificate.

Who can apply for Udyam Registration?

Any individual or entity looking to establish a micro, small or medium enterprise can apply for Udyam Registration. This includes proprietorships, Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs), partnership firms, companies, producer companies, limited liability partnerships, associations of persons, cooperative societies, and other undertakings.

What are the benefits of Udyam Registration?

Udyam Registration entitles MSMEs to various benefits like preference in government tenders, collateral-free bank loans, interest subsidy on overdrafts, tax rebates, capital subsidies, concessions on electricity bills, protection against delayed payments, and discounts on trademark/patent filing fees.

What documents are required for Udyam Registration?

The Udyam Registration process is based on self-declaration, and no documents need to be uploaded. Applicants only need to provide their Aadhaar number, PAN, and business bank account details.

Is Udyam Registration mandatory?

No, obtaining Udyam Registration is not mandatory for businesses. However, it is recommended to get registered to avail the various benefits offered by the government for MSMEs.

How do I apply for Udyam Registration for a new enterprise?

New enterprises can apply for Udyam Registration online through the Udyam Registration Portal. The process is based on self-declaration, and no document upload is required. Applicants need to provide their Aadhaar number, PAN, and business bank account details.

Do I need to renew my Udyam Registration?

No, the Udyam Registration Number is a permanent identification number, and there is no need for renewal of registration.

What are the revised MSME definition criteria?

The revised MSME definition, announced under the Atmanirbhar Bharat package, is based on composite criteria of investment and turnover. The distinction between manufacturing and service sectors has been eliminated. The investment and turnover limits have been revised upwards for micro, small, and medium enterprises.

Has the MSME definition been expanded recently?

Yes, in July 2021, the government announced that the wholesale and retail trade sectors (except for motor vehicles and motorcycles) would also be covered under the MSME classification, making them eligible for MSME registration.

How can I get help with Udyam Registration and other MSME-related services?

IndiaFilings offers assistance with Udyam Registration and provides LEDGERS Accounting Software for MSMEs. The software can help with estimates, invoicing, purchase tracking, filing GST returns, and generating GST e-way bills.

# MSME Udyam Registration - Get MSME's Udyam Registered Online

Udyam registration is the new process for registering MSME (micro, small and medium enterprises) launched by the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises on July 1, 2020. The Ministry had also revised the definition of MSMEs from the same date.  An enterprise for this process is known as Udyam, and its Registration Process is known as [Udyam Registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration). A permanent registration number will be issued after Registration.

## Udyam Registration Vs. Udyog Aadhaar registration

Udyam Registration or MSME Registration is nothing but a government registration that is provided along with a recognition certificate and a unique number. This registration is to certify micro/small/medium enterprises. The Udyog Aadhaar registration has been transformed to the Udyam registration since July 2020. Udyam registration has made the process more accessible than it was earlier, at the time of [Udyog Aadhaar registration.](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/udyog-aadhaar-for-msmes)Udyam registration is essential for availing the various benefits of schemes or programs of the Ministry of MSME, such as the Credit Guarantee Scheme, public procurement policy, additional edge in Government Tenders and protection against delayed payments, etc.

## Udyam Registration Certificate

After completion of the process of Udyam Registration, a certificate will be issued online. This Udyam Registration Certificate will have a dynamic QR Code from which the details about the enterprise can be accessed.

## Renewal of Udyam Registration

Udyam Registration Number is a permanent identification number, and there will be no need for renewal of Registration.

## Udyam Registration Benefits

The Udayam Registration is a simple process and there is no need to handle the paperwork for obtaining Udyam Registration. Having Udyam Registration for your venture entitles your Business to the following benefits:

- Special Preference in Procuring Government Tender
- Udyam registration will help to get the bank loans without Collateral/ Mortgage. 1 percent Exemption on the interest rate on Bank Overdraft (OD)
- There are various tax rebates available for Udyam registered enterprises.
- Higher preference is provided to businesses registered under Udyam for government license and certification.
- Registered Udyam gets tariff subsidies and tax and capital subsidies
- Concession in Electricity Bills
- It gives protection against the delay in payment from Buyers
- Tax Rebates
- Special 50% discount on Government fees for Trademark and Patent filing
- Fast Resolution of Disputes

[For more details on MSME Registration Benefits in India, click here](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/msme-registration-benefits-in-india)

## Who can apply for Udyam registration?

Any person who aspires to establish a micro, small, or medium enterprise can avail of Udyam Registration.Proprietorships, Hindu Undivided Family (HUF), Partnership Firms, One Person Companies, Private Limited Companies, Limited Companies, Producer Companies, Limited Liability Partnerships, any association of persons, cooperative societies, or any other undertaking can obtain MSME Udyam Registration in India.

## Revised MSME definition – The Atamnirbhar Bharat package

After 14 years since the MSME Development Act, a revision in the MSME definition was announced in the Atmnirbhar Bharat package on 13.05.2020 to bring more units under the purview of the schemes announced. According to this package, the composite criteria for the definition of MSME are investment and turnover; the limit has been revised upwards. The distinction between the service and the manufacturing sector has also been eliminated.

- The limit of the Micro units (both manufacturing and services) was increased to Rs. 1 Crore investment and Rs. 5 Crore turnover.
- Similarly, the limits of the small unit also increased to Rs. 10 Crore of investment and Rs 50 Crore of turnover.
- The limits of the medium enterprises were increased to Rs. 20 Crore of investment and Rs. 100 Crore turnover.

MSME Udyam Registration - Get MSME's Udyam Registered Online

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Composite Criteria: Investment in Plant / Machinery and Turnover** |
| **Sl.No** | **Type of Enterprises** | **Investment** | **Turnover** |
| 1 | Micro enterprises | Less than Rs.1 Crore | Less than Rs.5 Crore |
| 2 | Small enterprises | Less than Rs.10 Crore | Less than Rs.50 Crore |
| 3 | Medium enterprises | Less than Rs.20 Crore | Less than Rs.100 Crore |

Know more about the Highlights of[**the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyaan Economic Package**](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/atmanirbhar-bharat-coronavirus-economic-stimulus-package)

### **MSME Notification July 2021**: Addition of Retail and Wholesale Trade under MSME

Earlier, the MSME registration covered only the manufacturing and service industries. However, in July 2021, the government announced that the wholesale and retail trade will come under the MSME classification and thus can apply for MSME registration of their wholesale/retail trade business except for motor vehicles and motorcycles. Thus, manufacturing and service industries and wholesale and retail trade are covered and eligible to apply for MSME registration. [Click here to know more about the Addition of Retail and Wholesale Trade under MSME](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/revised-definition-of-msme-addition-of-retail-and-wholesale-trade)

## When to apply for MSME Udyam Registration registration?

Obtaining Udyam Registration is not mandatory and is at the sole discretion of the Entrepreneur. However, it is recommended that most businesses obtain MSME registration right after Registration to enjoy various benefits offered by the Government.

## Documents Required for Udyam Registration Online

The Online Udyam Registration application process is based on self-declaration, and there is no further requirement to upload any documents.The applicant will only need to furnish their 12-digit Aadhaar Number, PAN, and Bank Account details of Business for the registration process.

## Udyam registration of New Enterprise -  Udyam Registration Portal

The new enterprise is required to follow the below steps to register on Udyam Registration Portal:

- The new enterprise is willing to establish itself as an MSME and needs to apply for online Udyam Registration in Udyam Registration Portal.
- The application is based on self-declaration, and there is no further requirement to upload any documents, certificates, papers, or proofs. Udyam registration is free of cost.
-  An Aadhaar number is mandatory for obtaining Udyam Registration. Following Aadhaar number is required based on the type of firm

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Type of firm** | **The person whose Aadhaar number is required** |
| Proprietorship firm | Proprietor |
| Partnership firm | Managing partner |
| Hindu Undivided Family | Karta |
| Company or a Co-operative Society or a Trust or a Limited Liability Partnership | Authorized signatory |

- PAN and GST-linked details on investment and turnover of enterprises will be taken automatically from Government databases.
- MSME online system is fully integrated with Income Tax and GSTIN systems.
- On successful application submission, the enterprise will be assigned a 'Udyam Registration Number' (i.e., permanent identity number).
- On completion of the registration process, the enterprise shall be issued an 'Udyam Registration Certificate.'

Note:

Importantly, an enterprise can file only one Udyam Registration. Additionally, multiple numbers of enterprise activities, i.e., manufacturing, services, or both, can be added to one Udyam Registration.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions aboutMSME Udyam Registration.

What is Udyam Registration?

Udyam Registration is the new process introduced by the Government of India for registering Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs). It replaces the earlier Udyog Aadhaar registration process. After completing Udyam Registration, enterprises will be issued a permanent registration number and a recognition certificate.

Who can apply for Udyam Registration?

Any individual or entity looking to establish a micro, small or medium enterprise can apply for Udyam Registration. This includes proprietorships, Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs), partnership firms, companies, producer companies, limited liability partnerships, associations of persons, cooperative societies, and other undertakings.

What are the benefits of Udyam Registration?

Udyam Registration entitles MSMEs to various benefits like preference in government tenders, collateral-free bank loans, interest subsidy on overdrafts, tax rebates, capital subsidies, concessions on electricity bills, protection against delayed payments, and discounts on trademark/patent filing fees.

What documents are required for Udyam Registration?

The Udyam Registration process is based on self-declaration, and no documents need to be uploaded. Applicants only need to provide their Aadhaar number, PAN, and business bank account details.

Is Udyam Registration mandatory?

No, obtaining Udyam Registration is not mandatory for businesses. However, it is recommended to get registered to avail the various benefits offered by the government for MSMEs.

How do I apply for Udyam Registration for a new enterprise?

New enterprises can apply for Udyam Registration online through the Udyam Registration Portal. The process is based on self-declaration, and no document upload is required. Applicants need to provide their Aadhaar number, PAN, and business bank account details.

Do I need to renew my Udyam Registration?

No, the Udyam Registration Number is a permanent identification number, and there is no need for renewal of registration.

What are the revised MSME definition criteria?

The revised MSME definition, announced under the Atmanirbhar Bharat package, is based on composite criteria of investment and turnover. The distinction between manufacturing and service sectors has been eliminated. The investment and turnover limits have been revised upwards for micro, small, and medium enterprises.

Has the MSME definition been expanded recently?

Yes, in July 2021, the government announced that the wholesale and retail trade sectors (except for motor vehicles and motorcycles) would also be covered under the MSME classification, making them eligible for MSME registration.

How can I get help with Udyam Registration and other MSME-related services?

IndiaFilings offers assistance with Udyam Registration and provides LEDGERS Accounting Software for MSMEs. The software can help with estimates, invoicing, purchase tracking, filing GST returns, and generating GST e-way bills.

blogs.title: Benefits of Udyam Registration for MSME

content_sections.heading: Benefits of Udyam Registration for MSME
content_sections.content: [Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration) are the backbone of India's economy, contributing significantly to employment generation, industrial growth, and exports. Recognizing their importance, the Indian Government has implemented various measures to support and promote these enterprises. One such crucial measure is the [MSME registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration), which formalizes their status and opens the door to many benefits. In this article, we will delve into the extensive advantages of MSME registration to businesses across India.

content_sections.heading: What is Udyam Registration for MSMEs?
content_sections.content:
Udyam Registration, also known as MSME Registration, is like a special card given by the Government to small and medium-sized businesses in India. This card has a unique number and a certificate that says the company is a micro, small, or medium enterprise. It's a way of officially recognizing these types of businesses.Before, it used to be called [Udyog Aadhaar registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration), but since July 2020, it's been changed to Udyam Registration. This new system is designed to make things simpler and better for small businesses. It's like the Government's saying, "We see you and we support you!" This registration helps businesses become part of the country's economy more easily.

[Register Now!](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration)

content_sections.heading: Key Features of Udyam Registration
content_sections.content:
The Udyam Registration for enterprises offers several notable features:

- **Accessible to All:** Udyam Registration can be obtained by any individual for their enterprise. The process can be initiated through the official Udyam portal.
- **Fully Paperless and Digitalized:** The Udyam Registration process is entirely paperless and digital. Applicants are not required to upload any documents during the process.
- **No Registration Fees**: The registration process is free of charge. No fees need to be paid to any entity for obtaining Udyam Registration.
- **Issuance of Udyam Registration Certificate:** An e-certificate named the "Udyam Registration Certificate" will be provided upon successful registration. This certificate will contain a dynamic QR Code, allowing easy access to enterprise details.
- **Penalty for Misrepresentation:** Deliberate misrepresentation during the Udyam Registration or updating process can result in fines as outlined in section 27 of the MSME Act.
- **Integration with Tax Systems:** The Udyam online system is seamlessly linked with the Income Tax and [Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN)](https://www.indiafilings.com/gst-registration) systems. Enterprise investment and turnover details are automatically fetched from government databases.
- Exports Excluded from Turnover Calculation: Notably, turnover calculation excludes export-related figures.
- Eligibility for Priority Sector Lending: Enterprises with Udyam Registration qualify for priority sector lending from banks.

content_sections.heading: Benefits of Udyam Registration for Entity
content_sections.content: The Benefits Offered to MSME Business in India is explained in detail below:

content_sections.heading: Collateral-Free Bank Loans
content_sections.content: The Government of India has ushered in a significant advantage for small and micro-business sectors by providing access to credit without the need for collateral. This initiative assures much-needed funds for enterprises operating in these sectors. This scheme applies to both existing businesses and new ventures. To ensure the effective implementation of this Credit Guarantee Scheme for all Micro and Small Enterprises, the Government of India, in partnership with SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India) and the Ministry of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises, established a trust known as The Credit Guarantee Trust Fund Scheme.

content_sections.heading: Benefits of Priority Sector Lending for MSMEs
content_sections.content: The Reserve Bank of India outlines precise guidelines for Priority Sector Lending (PSL). Within this framework, several categories are identified under the priority sector: agriculture, Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), export credit, education, housing, social infrastructure, and renewable energy. Notably, the MSME sector holds a significant position within Priority Sector Lending. This classification means that bank loans extended to MSMEs following RBI guidelines receive the distinction of priority sector lending.

content_sections.heading: Patent Registration Subsidy
content_sections.content: The current regulatory framework extends a valuable privilege to Udyam Registered MSMEs: a substantial 50% subsidy on patent registration fees. This enticing incentive drives small businesses and enterprises to remain dedicated to innovation, thereby nurturing the continuous development of novel projects and advanced technologies. Accessing this subsidy necessitates submitting a formal application to the relevant ministries, unlocking a path to innovation-led growth.

content_sections.heading: Overdraft Interest Rate Exemption
content_sections.content: Businesses and enterprises registered as MSMEs under Udyam can capitalize on a favorable privilege: an exemption of 1% interest on OverDraft (OD). This provision, contingent upon the specific schemes offered by diverse banks, plays a pivotal role in fortifying the financial security of small-scale businesses, particularly during challenging market conditions where stability is paramount.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility for Industrial Promotion Subsidy
content_sections.content: Enterprises that secure the coveted MSME registration are positioned to avail themselves of subsidies designed to bolster Industrial Promotion, as sanctioned by the Government. This subsidy-centric approach uplifts and empowers businesses by reducing financial constraints and amplifying their growth potential.

content_sections.heading: Protection against Delayed Payments
content_sections.content: A common predicament encountered by MSMEs revolves around the issue of delayed payments, which can severely disrupt their operational continuity. To shield registered MSMEs, the Supreme Court has mandated a safeguarding mechanism: purchasers of goods or services from registered MSMEs must ensure that payments are made on the agreed-upon date or within 15 days from the moment of goods/services acceptance. Should the buyer deviate from this timeline, surpassing a payment delay of 45 days following approval, they are held accountable to compensate for their delay. This compensation takes the form of interest, calculated at a rate three times higher than that specified by the Reserve Bank of India.

content_sections.heading: Reduced Electricity Expenses
content_sections.content: Enterprises equipped with the esteemed [MSME Registration Certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration) are entitled to a tangible benefit: reduced charges on their electricity bills. This advantage mitigates a significant financial burden and empowers businesses to escalate production capacities and seamlessly accommodate a heightened influx of orders. This concession is particularly valuable as it addresses concerns associated with electricity costs and maintenance expenses. Micro, small, and medium enterprises can readily secure this advantageous arrangement by promptly submitting an application to the electricity department with their registration certificate.

content_sections.heading: Reimbursement for ISO Certification Costs
content_sections.content: Any micro, small, and medium enterprise with valid registration can seek reimbursement for the expenses incurred in acquiring an ISO certification. This initiative motivates entrepreneurs to pursue ISO certification for their businesses, enabling them to engage in international trade through high-quality exports.

content_sections.heading: Impressive Tax Advantages
content_sections.content: Depending on their industry, MSME business owners can harness remarkable tax advantages through the excise exemption scheme. Furthermore, during the initial stages of their business operations, these entrepreneurs can secure direct tax exemptions. These privileges give entrepreneurs a conducive environment to cultivate their ventures without the burden of extensive tax obligations.

content_sections.heading: Simplified License Approvals
content_sections.content: MSME registration translates into streamlined processes for acquiring licenses, permits, and registrations. This operational simplification minimizes bureaucratic complexities, propelling businesses toward operational efficiency and swift compliance.

content_sections.heading: Effortless Government Tender Applications for SMEs
content_sections.content: Registered MSMEs, operating under the umbrella of Udyam, enjoy the distinct advantage of smooth participation in government tenders. Additionally, they are granted exemptions during the application process, an arrangement designed to bolster their competitive edge in public procurement.

content_sections.heading: Benefits from the Central Government
content_sections.content: The central Government has orchestrated various strategic programs tailored for the growth and sustenance of MSMEs. This comprehensive support ecosystem encompasses schemes like Atma Nirbhar Bharat, which advocates self-reliance, Quality Management Standards, Quality Technology Tools, backing for women entrepreneurs, the aspiration for "zero effect and zero defect," and numerous other progressive initiatives. These collective endeavors orchestrated by the central Government engender an environment conducive to MSME expansion, empowering these enterprises to thrive and make meaningful contributions to the Indian economy.

content_sections.heading: Top 4 Government Loan Schemes for MSMEs:
MUDRA Loans for Small Businesses
content_sections.content: This pioneering scheme furnishes financial assistance to small businesses, nurturing their expansion and growth trajectories. [MUDRA loans](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/how-to-get-mudra-loan) accommodate a diverse range of funding needs, effectively catalyzing the entrepreneurial journey of MSMEs.

content_sections.heading: MSME Business Loans in 59 Minutes
content_sections.content: This innovative initiative is tailored to expedite the process of loan access. Eligible MSMEs are granted loan approvals within a remarkably swift span of [59 minutes](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/msme-loan-in-59-minutes). This efficient approach streamlines the pathway to funding, effectively addressing a critical aspect of business development.

content_sections.heading: Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises
content_sections.content: This strategic scheme assumes the role of an enabler, amplifying credit access for micro and small enterprises. By extending collateral-free loans, the [Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/cgtmse)offers the added assurance of partial repayment to lenders in the event of defaults. Consequently, this arrangement bolsters the credibility and creditworthiness of MSMEs.

content_sections.heading: Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme
content_sections.content: In response to the unprecedented challenges posed by the global pandemic, this scheme has been introduced to provide a safety net for MSMEs. By guaranteeing [emergency credit](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/emergency-credit-line-guarantee-scheme-eclgs-4-0)lines, this initiative is designed to alleviate financial stress during periods of adversity.

content_sections.heading: Global Business Opportunities
content_sections.content: A prominent feature of MSMEs' journey is the opportunity to participate in international fairs and trade shows. These platforms serve as avenues for showcasing products and services to a diverse and expansive global audience, fostering the expansion of business horizons beyond national boundaries.

content_sections.heading: Gaining Subsidies and More
content_sections.content: Registered MSMEs are poised to harness various advantages, including subsidies extended by the National Small Industries Corporation (NSIC). Moreover, these enterprises can access credit ratings that contribute to enhanced financial resilience. The Industrial Promotion Subsidy (IPS) eligibility further reinforces its financial robustness and growth trajectory.To access the benefits tailored for your micro, small, or medium-sized enterprise, you need to get Udyam Registration.

# Benefits of Udyam Registration for MSME

[Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration) are the backbone of India's economy, contributing significantly to employment generation, industrial growth, and exports. Recognizing their importance, the Indian Government has implemented various measures to support and promote these enterprises. One such crucial measure is the [MSME registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration), which formalizes their status and opens the door to many benefits. In this article, we will delve into the extensive advantages of MSME registration to businesses across India.

## What is Udyam Registration for MSMEs?

Udyam Registration, also known as MSME Registration, is like a special card given by the Government to small and medium-sized businesses in India. This card has a unique number and a certificate that says the company is a micro, small, or medium enterprise. It's a way of officially recognizing these types of businesses.Before, it used to be called [Udyog Aadhaar registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration), but since July 2020, it's been changed to Udyam Registration. This new system is designed to make things simpler and better for small businesses. It's like the Government's saying, "We see you and we support you!" This registration helps businesses become part of the country's economy more easily.

[Register Now!](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration)

## Key Features of Udyam Registration

The Udyam Registration for enterprises offers several notable features:

- **Accessible to All:** Udyam Registration can be obtained by any individual for their enterprise. The process can be initiated through the official Udyam portal.
- **Fully Paperless and Digitalized:** The Udyam Registration process is entirely paperless and digital. Applicants are not required to upload any documents during the process.
- **No Registration Fees**: The registration process is free of charge. No fees need to be paid to any entity for obtaining Udyam Registration.
- **Issuance of Udyam Registration Certificate:** An e-certificate named the "Udyam Registration Certificate" will be provided upon successful registration. This certificate will contain a dynamic QR Code, allowing easy access to enterprise details.
- **Penalty for Misrepresentation:** Deliberate misrepresentation during the Udyam Registration or updating process can result in fines as outlined in section 27 of the MSME Act.
- **Integration with Tax Systems:** The Udyam online system is seamlessly linked with the Income Tax and [Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN)](https://www.indiafilings.com/gst-registration) systems. Enterprise investment and turnover details are automatically fetched from government databases.
- Exports Excluded from Turnover Calculation: Notably, turnover calculation excludes export-related figures.
- Eligibility for Priority Sector Lending: Enterprises with Udyam Registration qualify for priority sector lending from banks.

## Benefits of Udyam Registration for Entity

The Benefits Offered to MSME Business in India is explained in detail below:

## Financial Benefits for MSME

### Collateral-Free Bank Loans

The Government of India has ushered in a significant advantage for small and micro-business sectors by providing access to credit without the need for collateral. This initiative assures much-needed funds for enterprises operating in these sectors. This scheme applies to both existing businesses and new ventures. To ensure the effective implementation of this Credit Guarantee Scheme for all Micro and Small Enterprises, the Government of India, in partnership with SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India) and the Ministry of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises, established a trust known as The Credit Guarantee Trust Fund Scheme.

### Benefits of Priority Sector Lending for MSMEs

The Reserve Bank of India outlines precise guidelines for Priority Sector Lending (PSL). Within this framework, several categories are identified under the priority sector: agriculture, Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), export credit, education, housing, social infrastructure, and renewable energy. Notably, the MSME sector holds a significant position within Priority Sector Lending. This classification means that bank loans extended to MSMEs following RBI guidelines receive the distinction of priority sector lending.

### Patent Registration Subsidy

The current regulatory framework extends a valuable privilege to Udyam Registered MSMEs: a substantial 50% subsidy on patent registration fees. This enticing incentive drives small businesses and enterprises to remain dedicated to innovation, thereby nurturing the continuous development of novel projects and advanced technologies. Accessing this subsidy necessitates submitting a formal application to the relevant ministries, unlocking a path to innovation-led growth.

### Overdraft Interest Rate Exemption

Businesses and enterprises registered as MSMEs under Udyam can capitalize on a favorable privilege: an exemption of 1% interest on OverDraft (OD). This provision, contingent upon the specific schemes offered by diverse banks, plays a pivotal role in fortifying the financial security of small-scale businesses, particularly during challenging market conditions where stability is paramount.

### Eligibility for Industrial Promotion Subsidy

Enterprises that secure the coveted MSME registration are positioned to avail themselves of subsidies designed to bolster Industrial Promotion, as sanctioned by the Government. This subsidy-centric approach uplifts and empowers businesses by reducing financial constraints and amplifying their growth potential.

### Protection against Delayed Payments

A common predicament encountered by MSMEs revolves around the issue of delayed payments, which can severely disrupt their operational continuity. To shield registered MSMEs, the Supreme Court has mandated a safeguarding mechanism: purchasers of goods or services from registered MSMEs must ensure that payments are made on the agreed-upon date or within 15 days from the moment of goods/services acceptance. Should the buyer deviate from this timeline, surpassing a payment delay of 45 days following approval, they are held accountable to compensate for their delay. This compensation takes the form of interest, calculated at a rate three times higher than that specified by the Reserve Bank of India.

### Reduced Electricity Expenses

Enterprises equipped with the esteemed [MSME Registration Certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration) are entitled to a tangible benefit: reduced charges on their electricity bills. This advantage mitigates a significant financial burden and empowers businesses to escalate production capacities and seamlessly accommodate a heightened influx of orders. This concession is particularly valuable as it addresses concerns associated with electricity costs and maintenance expenses. Micro, small, and medium enterprises can readily secure this advantageous arrangement by promptly submitting an application to the electricity department with their registration certificate.

### Reimbursement for ISO Certification Costs

Any micro, small, and medium enterprise with valid registration can seek reimbursement for the expenses incurred in acquiring an ISO certification. This initiative motivates entrepreneurs to pursue ISO certification for their businesses, enabling them to engage in international trade through high-quality exports.

## Tax Benefits offered to MSME

### Impressive Tax Advantages

Depending on their industry, MSME business owners can harness remarkable tax advantages through the excise exemption scheme. Furthermore, during the initial stages of their business operations, these entrepreneurs can secure direct tax exemptions. These privileges give entrepreneurs a conducive environment to cultivate their ventures without the burden of extensive tax obligations.

## Operational Benefits

### Simplified License Approvals

MSME registration translates into streamlined processes for acquiring licenses, permits, and registrations. This operational simplification minimizes bureaucratic complexities, propelling businesses toward operational efficiency and swift compliance.

### Effortless Government Tender Applications for SMEs

Registered MSMEs, operating under the umbrella of Udyam, enjoy the distinct advantage of smooth participation in government tenders. Additionally, they are granted exemptions during the application process, an arrangement designed to bolster their competitive edge in public procurement.

The central Government has orchestrated various strategic programs tailored for the growth and sustenance of MSMEs. This comprehensive support ecosystem encompasses schemes like Atma Nirbhar Bharat, which advocates self-reliance, Quality Management Standards, Quality Technology Tools, backing for women entrepreneurs, the aspiration for "zero effect and zero defect," and numerous other progressive initiatives. These collective endeavors orchestrated by the central Government engender an environment conducive to MSME expansion, empowering these enterprises to thrive and make meaningful contributions to the Indian economy.

This pioneering scheme furnishes financial assistance to small businesses, nurturing their expansion and growth trajectories. [MUDRA loans](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/how-to-get-mudra-loan) accommodate a diverse range of funding needs, effectively catalyzing the entrepreneurial journey of MSMEs.

This innovative initiative is tailored to expedite the process of loan access. This efficient approach streamlines the pathway to funding, effectively addressing a critical aspect of business development.

This strategic scheme assumes the role of an enabler, amplifying credit access for micro and small enterprises. By extending collateral-free loans, the [Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/cgtmse)offers the added assurance of partial repayment to lenders in the event of defaults. Consequently, this arrangement bolsters the credibility and creditworthiness of MSMEs.

In response to the unprecedented challenges posed by the global pandemic, this scheme has been introduced to provide a safety net for MSMEs. By guaranteeing [emergency credit](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/emergency-credit-line-guarantee-scheme-eclgs-4-0)lines, this initiative is designed to alleviate financial stress during periods of adversity.

A prominent feature of MSMEs' journey is the opportunity to participate in international fairs and trade shows. These platforms serve as avenues for showcasing products and services to a diverse and expansive global audience, fostering the expansion of business horizons beyond national boundaries.

content_sections.heading: MSME Clarification on Selection of Financial Year for Udyam Registration
content_sections.content: The[Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/msme-registration-benefits-in-india) has issued a notification dated 28.09.2021 regarding Clarification on Selection of Financial Year for Udyam Registration. The financial year is mandatory to get details of the enterprises' Investment, Turnover, and Export value for the classification of MSME while registering on Udyam Portal. The current article briefs the MSME's clarification regarding Selection of the Financial Year for [Udyam Registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration).

content_sections.heading: Synopsis of MSME Notification
content_sections.content:
The Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises has received several representations from MSMEs stakeholders concerning the selection of the financial year of data in respect of Investment and Turnover and the export value for the MSME classification while registering on Udyam Portal.

- MSME now clarified that details of Investment, Turnover, and Export would be taken from Income Tax Department and [GSTN](https://www.indiafilings.com/gst-registration)from the relevant Financial Year for the MSME classification.
- For filing on the Udyam Portal for the Financial Year 2020-21, the data (Investment, Turnover, and Export) for Financial Year 2018-2019 was taken from the I.T. Department and GSTN.

The official notification of MSME about MSME Clarification on Selection of Financial Year for Udyam Registration is attached here for reference:

content_sections.heading: MSME Classification and Udyam Registration
content_sections.content:
The ministry has classified the entity as Micro, Small, and Medium based on the investment in plant, machinery, or equipment. This new method of categorizing MSME was announced vide notification No. S.O. (E) dated 26.06.2020. Any person who intends to establish an MSME must file Udyam Registration online in the Udyam Registration portal. The notification also deals with the following procedures:

- Composite criteria of investment and Turnover for classification
- Calculation of investment in plant and machinery or equipment
- Calculation of Turnover
- Udyam MSME Registration process
- Registration of existing enterprises
- Updating of information and transition period in Udyam Portal
- Facilitation and grievance redressal of enterprises

Know more about the [Procedure and criteria for MSME Classification and Udyam Registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/msme-udyam-registration)

content_sections.heading: GSTIN Not Mandatory for MSME Udyam Registration
content_sections.content:
The government has earlier provided that [PAN](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/instant-pan-using-aadhaar)and GSTIN are mandatory for MSME Udyam Registration. Vide a Notification S.O. 1055(E) dated 5th March 2021 has relaxed the condition.Subsequently, the Notification No. S.O. (E) dated 26.06.2020 has been amended on 05.03.2021 to facilitate the exemption from the requirement of having GSTIN as per the CGST Act, 2017.

- In case of any proprietorship firm not registered under any Act or rules of the Central Government or the State Government, the proprietor may use their PAN to register the firm in the Udyam Registration portal.
- MSME also clarified that PAN is mandatory for all other types of enterprises for Udyam Registration.

content_sections.heading: Investment and Turnover details for Udyam Registration
content_sections.content:
- MSME announced that the data of Investment and Turnover either get auto-filled/ fetched from the Income Tax Department and GSTN  for those entities who have filed Income Tax  and GST Returns
- Investment and Turnover must be filed on a self-declaration basis by those enterprises yet to file the I.T. and GST Returns.

Note: The data which gets auto-filled/ fetched from the I.T. Department and GSTN is the data that the respective Departments had finalized after rectification for the relevant Financial Year.

content_sections.heading: MSME Udyam Registration for the Financial Year 2020-21
content_sections.content: The Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises clarified that for filing on Udyam Portal for the Financial Year 2020-21, the data of the Financial year 2018-2019, in respect of Investment and Turnover from the Income Tax Department and Goods and Services Tax Network, were auto-populated to avoid any deviation in data that may affect the MSME classification.For the Financial year 2018-19, the timeline for filing Income Tax Returns was July 2019. Also, the process of GST Return for the Financial Year 2018-19 follows similar timelines. Hence, frozen data of 2018-19 has been considered for MSME registration and classification during 2020-21.

content_sections.heading: Financial Year Selection Procedure for Udyam Registration
content_sections.content:
To summarize, the following procedure has been adopted concerning data (auto-filled/ fetched) in the UDYAM Registration Portal with effect from 01 .07.2020 onwards:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Financial Year of Registration in Udyam Portal and Classification of MSME** | **Data(Investment, Turnover, and Export) taken or to be taken** **from the I.T. department and GSTN from the relevant financial year** |
| 2020-2021 | 2018-2019 |
| 2021-2022 | 2019-2020 |
| 2022-2023 | 2020-2021 |

MSME now clarified that the system would take details of Investment, Turnover, and exports from the Income Tax Department and GSTN from the relevant Financial Year.

content_sections.heading: MSME Udyam Registration for the Financial Year 2022-2023
content_sections.content:
- The new enterprise is willing to establish itself as an MSME and needs to apply for online Udyam Registration in Udyam Registration Portal.
- The application is based on self-declaration, and there is no further requirement to upload any documents, certificates, papers, or proofs. Udyam registration is free of cost.
- An Aadhaar number is mandatory for obtaining Udyam Registration.
- PAN and GST-linked details on investment and Turnover of enterprises will be taken automatically from Income Tax Department and Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN). MSME online system is fully integrated with Income Tax and GSTIN systems.

# MSME Clarification on Selection of Financial Year for Udyam Registration

The[Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/msme-registration-benefits-in-india) has issued a notification dated 28.09.2021 regarding Clarification on Selection of Financial Year for Udyam Registration. The financial year is mandatory to get details of the enterprises' Investment, Turnover, and Export value for the classification of MSME while registering on Udyam Portal. The current article briefs the MSME's clarification regarding Selection of the Financial Year for [Udyam Registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/udyam-registration).

## Synopsis of MSME Notification

The Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises has received several representations from MSMEs stakeholders concerning the selection of the financial year of data in respect of Investment and Turnover and the export value for the MSME classification while registering on Udyam Portal.

- MSME now clarified that details of Investment, Turnover, and Export would be taken from Income Tax Department and [GSTN](https://www.indiafilings.com/gst-registration)from the relevant Financial Year for the MSME classification.
- For filing on the Udyam Portal for the Financial Year 2020-21, the data (Investment, Turnover, and Export) for Financial Year 2018-2019 was taken from the I.T. Department and GSTN.

The official notification of MSME about MSME Clarification on Selection of Financial Year for Udyam Registration is attached here for reference:

## MSME Classification and Udyam Registration

The ministry has classified the entity as Micro, Small, and Medium based on the investment in plant, machinery, or equipment. This new method of categorizing MSME was announced vide notification No. S.O. (E) dated 26.06.2020. Any person who intends to establish an MSME must file Udyam Registration online in the Udyam Registration portal. The notification also deals with the following procedures:

- Composite criteria of investment and Turnover for classification
- Calculation of investment in plant and machinery or equipment
- Calculation of Turnover
- Udyam MSME Registration process
- Registration of existing enterprises
- Updating of information and transition period in Udyam Portal
- Facilitation and grievance redressal of enterprises

Know more about the [Procedure and criteria for MSME Classification and Udyam Registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/msme-udyam-registration)

## GSTIN Not Mandatory for MSME Udyam Registration

The government has earlier provided that [PAN](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/instant-pan-using-aadhaar)and GSTIN are mandatory for MSME Udyam Registration. Vide a Notification S.O. 1055(E) dated 5th March 2021 has relaxed the condition.Subsequently, the Notification No. S.O. (E) dated 26.06.2020 has been amended on 05.03.2021 to facilitate the exemption from the requirement of having GSTIN as per the CGST Act, 2017.

- In case of any proprietorship firm not registered under any Act or rules of the Central Government or the State Government, the proprietor may use their PAN to register the firm in the Udyam Registration portal.
- MSME also clarified that PAN is mandatory for all other types of enterprises for Udyam Registration.

## Investment and Turnover details for Udyam Registration

- MSME announced that the data of Investment and Turnover either get auto-filled/ fetched from the Income Tax Department and GSTN  for those entities who have filed Income Tax  and GST Returns
- Investment and Turnover must be filed on a self-declaration basis by those enterprises yet to file the I.T. and GST Returns.

Note: The data which gets auto-filled/ fetched from the I.T. Department and GSTN is the data that the respective Departments had finalized after rectification for the relevant Financial Year.

## MSME Udyam Registration for the Financial Year 2020-21

The Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises clarified that for filing on Udyam Portal for the Financial Year 2020-21, the data of the Financial year 2018-2019, in respect of Investment and Turnover from the Income Tax Department and Goods and Services Tax Network, were auto-populated to avoid any deviation in data that may affect the MSME classification.For the Financial year 2018-19, the timeline for filing Income Tax Returns was July 2019. Also, the process of GST Return for the Financial Year 2018-19 follows similar timelines. Hence, frozen data of 2018-19 has been considered for MSME registration and classification during 2020-21.

## Financial Year Selection Procedure for Udyam Registration

To summarize, the following procedure has been adopted concerning data (auto-filled/ fetched) in the UDYAM Registration Portal with effect from 01 .07.2020 onwards:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Financial Year of Registration in Udyam Portal and Classification of MSME** | **Data(Investment, Turnover, and Export) taken or to be taken** **from the I.T. department and GSTN from the relevant financial year** |
| 2020-2021 | 2018-2019 |
| 2021-2022 | 2019-2020 |
| 2022-2023 | 2020-2021 |

MSME now clarified that the system would take details of Investment, Turnover, and exports from the Income Tax Department and GSTN from the relevant Financial Year.

## MSME Udyam Registration for the Financial Year 2022-2023

- The new enterprise is willing to establish itself as an MSME and needs to apply for online Udyam Registration in Udyam Registration Portal.
- The application is based on self-declaration, and there is no further requirement to upload any documents, certificates, papers, or proofs. Udyam registration is free of cost.
- An Aadhaar number is mandatory for obtaining Udyam Registration.
- PAN and GST-linked details on investment and Turnover of enterprises will be taken automatically from Income Tax Department and Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN). MSME online system is fully integrated with Income Tax and GSTIN systems.
- According to this notification, For Registration in the Udyam Portal and the Classification of MSME for the Financial Year 2022-2023,  Details of Investment, Turnover, and Export will be taken from the details registered in the financial year 2020-2021 in the I.T. & GSTN  department.
- On successful application submission, the enterprise will be assigned an 'Udyam Registration Number' (i.e., permanent identity number).
- On completion of the registration process, the enterprise shall be issued an 'Udyam Registration Certificate.
