content_sections.heading: BIS Certificate for Import
content_sections.content: Every country has its own regulatory framework for manufacturing and selling goods, and India is no exception. Importers bring various products into India for sale and distribution, but these products must comply with Indian quality and safety standards. As per Indian Standards, all imported products must be BIS-certified before being sold in the Indian market. A BIS Import Certificate allows the manufacturer to use the ISI Mark, ensuring that the product meets the necessary quality benchmarks. Before delving deeper, let’s first understand what BIS is.

content_sections.heading: What is BIS?
content_sections.content:
BIS stands for the Bureau of Indian Standards, the national body responsible for the standardisation, quality certification, and marking of goods in India. BIS develops and implements standards to ensure that products meet essential safety, performance, and reliability benchmarks.

To maintain product quality and consumer safety, BIS runs various certification programs for both Indian and foreign manufacturers, allowing them to use the ISI (Indian Standards Institute) mark on their products.

![BIS Certificate for Imports](https://img.indiafilings.com/guides/isimark.png)

These certification schemes help ensure that the market is supplied with high-quality, risk-free, and reliable products.

content_sections.heading: Importance of a BIS Certificate for Import of Goods
content_sections.content:
Any product being imported into India must have a [BIS Certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/how-to-get-bis-certification-in-india) for Import for the following key reasons:

- Ensures Safety & Reliability – Confirms that the imported product is safe, reliable, and meets quality standards.
- Compliance with Indian Standards – Verifies that the product aligns with applicable Indian regulations.
- Competitive Advantage – Provides an edge over competitors by demonstrating adherence to strict quality norms.
- Consumer Protection – Guarantees that the public receives high-quality, risk-free, and safe products.
- Legal Requirement for Market Entry – Enables legal sale of products in the Indian market.
- Proof of Certification & Testing – Serves as evidence that the product has undergone testing and certification.
- Authorization to Use the ISI Mark – Allows manufacturers and importers to use the standard BIS mark on their products.
- Mandatory for Certain Products – Required for goods listed under the BIS mandatory certification list.

Now that you understand why a BIS certificate is required for import in India let’s explore the different types of BIS certifications an importer may need.

To sell imported products in India, the importer must ensure that the foreign manufacturer obtains BIS certification under one of the BIS certification schemes.

There are two primary types of BIS certification for importers, depending on the product category:

- Foreign Manufacturer Certification Scheme (FMCS) – Required for most imported products except electronics and IT goods.
- Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) – Mandatory for electronics and IT products.

content_sections.heading: Role of an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR)
content_sections.content:
To obtain a BIS Certificate for Import under either the FMCS or CRS schemes, all foreign manufacturers must appoint an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR). The AIR is responsible for:

- Submitting the BIS application on behalf of the foreign manufacturer.
- Ensuring compliance with the BIS Act, rules, and regulations.
- Coordinating with BIS authorities for certification processes and factory inspections.

content_sections.heading: Types of BIS Certificates for Importers
content_sections.content: The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) provides two primary types of certifications for importers based on the nature of the products being imported:

content_sections.heading: CRS Registration (Compulsory Registration Scheme)
content_sections.content:
CRS Registration is mandatory for importers of electronic products under the guidelines set by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).

- Applicable to: All electronic and IT products notified under the CRS Scheme.
- Purpose: Ensures imported electronic products comply with Indian safety and quality standards.
- Requirement: Importers must register their electronic products under CRS before selling them in India.

content_sections.heading: FMCS Certification (Foreign Manufacturer Certification Scheme)
content_sections.content:
The FMCS Certification applies to all other imported products except those covered under the CRS scheme. It allows foreign manufacturers to obtain BIS certification and use the ISI mark on their products.

- Applicable to: Non-electronic imported products (e.g., steel, cement, automotive parts, etc.).
- Purpose: Ensures compliance with Indian Standards (IS) for product safety, quality, and performance.
- Requirement: Importers must ensure that the foreign manufacturer of the product has obtained FMCS certification to sell their goods in the Indian market.

By securing the appropriate BIS certification, importers can legally distribute their products in India while ensuring compliance with national quality and safety regulations.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BIS Registration for Importers
content_sections.content: Importers must provide specific documents based on the type of BIS certification they are applying for. The required documents vary depending on whether the importer is opting for CRS Registration or FMCS Certification. Below is a breakdown of the necessary documents for each scheme:

content_sections.heading: Documents for CRS Registration (Compulsory Registration Scheme)
content_sections.content:
CRS registration is mandatory for importers of electronic and IT products. The following documents are required:

- Nomination Letter of Authorized Indian Representative (AIR)
- Test Report for the product from a BIS-recognized lab
- Undertaking regarding the product's compliance with Indian Standards
- ISO Certificate of the foreign manufacturer
- Product Manual for the applied devices
- [Trademark Certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/trademark-registration) (if available or required)
- Testing Documents such as the Filled CCL (Critical Component List) and
- CDF (Construction Data Form)
- Authorised Indian Representative (AIR) Affidavit (for foreign manufacturers)
- Trademark Authorization Letter (if the brand is not owned by the manufacturer)
- Authorization Letter (if the signatory is someone other than the manufacturing head)

content_sections.heading: Documents for FMCS Certification (Foreign Manufacturer Certification Scheme)
content_sections.content:
FMCS certification applies to non-electronic imported products and requires additional documents:

- List of Manufacturing Equipment used in the production process
- List of Machinery used in the manufacturing plant
- Manufacturing Plant Layout Plan
- Brand Documents, such as a trademark certificate (if applicable)
- Business License or equivalent Incorporation Certificate
- Testing Report of Raw Materials used in product manufacturing
- Refundable Performance Bank Guarantee of $10,000, which must be submitted to BIS

By ensuring all necessary documents are prepared and submitted correctly, importers can streamline the BIS certification process and avoid unnecessary delays.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for a BIS Certificate for Import in India?
content_sections.content: To successfully obtain a BIS certificate for your product, follow these simple steps:

content_sections.heading: Step 1: Identify the Relevant Standard
content_sections.content: The first step is to determine the applicable Indian Standard (IS) for your product. Each product category has a designated IS code specifying the safety and quality requirements. Understanding these standards ensures compliance with BIS regulations.

content_sections.heading: Step 2: Prepare Documentation
content_sections.content:
Submit a complete application to BIS, including:

- Product details
- Manufacturing process information
- Quality control measures
- Testing procedures

Ensure that all documents are accurate and complete to prevent unnecessary delays in the certification process.

content_sections.heading: Step 3: Product Testing
content_sections.content: Your product must undergo testing at a BIS-recognized laboratory to verify its compliance with Indian Standards. This ensures that the product meets the quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.

content_sections.heading: Step 4: Factory Inspection
content_sections.content:
Following successful product testing, BIS officials will conduct an inspection of your manufacturing facility. This assessment includes:

- Evaluation of the production process
- Review of quality control systems
- Verification of adherence to Indian Standards

The goal is to confirm that your manufacturing process consistently produces standard-compliant products.

content_sections.heading: Step 5: Grant of BIS Certificate
content_sections.content:
Once the product clears both testing and inspection, BIS will grant the license to use the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) on the product.

- Validity – The BIS certification remains valid for a specific period.
- Renewal Requirement – Manufacturers must renew the certification periodically to maintain compliance.

By obtaining a BIS certificate, importers ensure that their products meet Indian regulatory requirements, enabling smooth customs clearance and market entry in India.

content_sections.heading: Identification of IS Mark for Imported Products
content_sections.content: Before applying for BIS registration, it is crucial to determine the applicable Indian Standard (IS) mark for the imported product. Each product category has a specific IS standard, ensuring compliance with Indian quality and safety norms. Importers can visit the official BIS website and search by product name to find the relevant standard applicable to their goods.

content_sections.heading: How to Import Goods Without a BIS Certificate?
content_sections.content: In certain cases, importing goods without a BIS certificate is possible under specific conditions. Below are the scenarios where you can import products without mandatory BIS registration:

content_sections.heading: Importing Product Samples for Testing & Research
content_sections.content:
- Importers can bring in product samples without a BIS certificate only for testing, research, and development purposes.
- You must assure customs that the imported goods will be used exclusively for testing and evaluation.
- Limitations: The same model can only be imported once for sampling.
- The customs clearance process must still be followed for approval.

content_sections.heading: Importing for Personal Use
content_sections.content:
- BIS registration is not required if you are importing products for personal use.
- According to the Department of Electronics & Information Technology (DeitY), end-users face no restrictions on bringing in products for personal consumption.

content_sections.heading: Temporary Import for Exhibitions & Trade Fairs
content_sections.content:
- Special permissions are required for temporary display import.
- Must re-export or dispose of items per BIS regulations

content_sections.heading: Cost of BIS Certificate for Import

The cost of obtaining a BIS certificate for import varies based on the product type and the applicable certification scheme. The total expense generally includes:

- Product Testing Fee – Cost of testing the product in a BIS-recognized laboratory to ensure compliance with Indian Standards.
- Inspection Fee – Covers the cost of BIS officials inspecting the manufacturing facility.
- Marking Fee – Fee for using the ISI mark or CRS mark on the certified product.
- Performance Bank Guarantee (For FMCS Applicants) – Foreign manufacturers applying under the FMCS scheme must deposit a refundable performance bank guarantee of $10,000 with BIS.

# BIS Certificate for Import

Every country has its own regulatory framework for manufacturing and selling goods, and India is no exception. Importers bring various products into India for sale and distribution, but these products must comply with Indian quality and safety standards. As per Indian Standards, all imported products must be BIS-certified before being sold in the Indian market. A BIS Import Certificate allows the manufacturer to use the ISI Mark, ensuring that the product meets the necessary quality benchmarks. Before delving deeper, let’s first understand what BIS is.

## What is BIS?

BIS stands for the Bureau of Indian Standards, the national body responsible for the standardisation, quality certification, and marking of goods in India. BIS develops and implements standards to ensure that products meet essential safety, performance, and reliability benchmarks.

To maintain product quality and consumer safety, BIS runs various certification programs for both Indian and foreign manufacturers, allowing them to use the ISI (Indian Standards Institute) mark on their products.

![BIS Certificate for Imports](https://img.indiafilings.com/guides/isimark.png)

These certification schemes help ensure that the market is supplied with high-quality, risk-free, and reliable products.

## Importance of a BIS Certificate for Import of Goods

Any product being imported into India must have a [BIS Certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/how-to-get-bis-certification-in-india) for Import for the following key reasons:

- Ensures Safety & Reliability – Confirms that the imported product is safe, reliable, and meets quality standards.
- Compliance with Indian Standards – Verifies that the product aligns with applicable Indian regulations.
- Competitive Advantage – Provides an edge over competitors by demonstrating adherence to strict quality norms.
- Consumer Protection – Guarantees that the public receives high-quality, risk-free, and safe products.
- Legal Requirement for Market Entry – Enables legal sale of products in the Indian market.
- Proof of Certification & Testing – Serves as evidence that the product has undergone testing and certification.
- Authorization to Use the ISI Mark – Allows manufacturers and importers to use the standard BIS mark on their products.
- Mandatory for Certain Products – Required for goods listed under the BIS mandatory certification list.

Now that you understand why a BIS certificate is required for import in India let’s explore the different types of BIS certifications an importer may need.

To sell imported products in India, the importer must ensure that the foreign manufacturer obtains BIS certification under one of the BIS certification schemes.

There are two primary types of BIS certification for importers, depending on the product category:

- Foreign Manufacturer Certification Scheme (FMCS) – Required for most imported products except electronics and IT goods.
- Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) – Mandatory for electronics and IT products.

### Role of an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR)

To obtain a BIS Certificate for Import under either the FMCS or CRS schemes, all foreign manufacturers must appoint an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR). The AIR is responsible for:

- Submitting the BIS application on behalf of the foreign manufacturer.
- Ensuring compliance with the BIS Act, rules, and regulations.
- Coordinating with BIS authorities for certification processes and factory inspections.

## Types of BIS Certificates for Importers

The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) provides two primary types of certifications for importers based on the nature of the products being imported:

### CRS Registration (Compulsory Registration Scheme)

CRS Registration is mandatory for importers of electronic products under the guidelines set by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).

- Applicable to: All electronic and IT products notified under the CRS Scheme.
- Purpose: Ensures imported electronic products comply with Indian safety and quality standards.
- Requirement: Importers must register their electronic products under CRS before selling them in India.

### FMCS Certification (Foreign Manufacturer Certification Scheme)

The FMCS Certification applies to all other imported products except those covered under the CRS scheme. It allows foreign manufacturers to obtain BIS certification and use the ISI mark on their products.

- Applicable to: Non-electronic imported products (e.g., steel, cement, automotive parts, etc.).
- Purpose: Ensures compliance with Indian Standards (IS) for product safety, quality, and performance.
- Requirement: Importers must ensure that the foreign manufacturer of the product has obtained FMCS certification to sell their goods in the Indian market.

By securing the appropriate BIS certification, importers can legally distribute their products in India while ensuring compliance with national quality and safety regulations.

## Documents Required for BIS Registration for Importers

Importers must provide specific documents based on the type of BIS certification they are applying for. The required documents vary depending on whether the importer is opting for CRS Registration or FMCS Certification. Below is a breakdown of the necessary documents for each scheme:

### Documents for CRS Registration (Compulsory Registration Scheme)

CRS registration is mandatory for importers of electronic and IT products. The following documents are required:

- Nomination Letter of Authorized Indian Representative (AIR)
- Test Report for the product from a BIS-recognized lab
- Undertaking regarding the product's compliance with Indian Standards
- ISO Certificate of the foreign manufacturer
- Product Manual for the applied devices
- [Trademark Certificate](https://www.indiafilings.com/trademark-registration) (if available or required)
- Testing Documents such as the Filled CCL (Critical Component List) and
- CDF (Construction Data Form)
- Authorised Indian Representative (AIR) Affidavit (for foreign manufacturers)
- Trademark Authorization Letter (if the brand is not owned by the manufacturer)
- Authorization Letter (if the signatory is someone other than the manufacturing head)

### Documents for FMCS Certification (Foreign Manufacturer Certification Scheme)

FMCS certification applies to non-electronic imported products and requires additional documents:

- List of Manufacturing Equipment used in the production process
- List of Machinery used in the manufacturing plant
- Manufacturing Plant Layout Plan
- Brand Documents, such as a trademark certificate (if applicable)
- Business License or equivalent Incorporation Certificate
- Testing Report of Raw Materials used in product manufacturing
- Refundable Performance Bank Guarantee of $10,000, which must be submitted to BIS

By ensuring all necessary documents are prepared and submitted correctly, importers can streamline the BIS certification process and avoid unnecessary delays.

## How to Apply for a BIS Certificate for Import in India?

To successfully obtain a BIS certificate for your product, follow these simple steps:

### Step 1: Identify the Relevant Standard

The first step is to determine the applicable Indian Standard (IS) for your product. Each product category has a designated IS code specifying the safety and quality requirements. Understanding these standards ensures compliance with BIS regulations.

### Step 2: Prepare Documentation

Submit a complete application to BIS, including:

- Product details
- Manufacturing process information
- Quality control measures
- Testing procedures

Ensure that all documents are accurate and complete to prevent unnecessary delays in the certification process.

### Step 3: Product Testing

Your product must undergo testing at a BIS-recognized laboratory to verify its compliance with Indian Standards. This ensures that the product meets the quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.

### Step 4: Factory Inspection

Following successful product testing, BIS officials will conduct an inspection of your manufacturing facility. This assessment includes:

- Evaluation of the production process
- Review of quality control systems
- Verification of adherence to Indian Standards

The goal is to confirm that your manufacturing process consistently produces standard-compliant products.

### Step 5: Grant of BIS Certificate

Once the product clears both testing and inspection, BIS will grant the license to use the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) on the product.

- Validity – The BIS certification remains valid for a specific period.
- Renewal Requirement – Manufacturers must renew the certification periodically to maintain compliance.

By obtaining a BIS certificate, importers ensure that their products meet Indian regulatory requirements, enabling smooth customs clearance and market entry in India.

## Identification of IS Mark for Imported Products

Before applying for BIS registration, it is crucial to determine the applicable Indian Standard (IS) mark for the imported product. Each product category has a specific IS standard, ensuring compliance with Indian quality and safety norms. Importers can visit the official BIS website and search by product name to find the relevant standard applicable to their goods.

## How to Import Goods Without a BIS Certificate?

In certain cases, importing goods without a BIS certificate is possible under specific conditions. Below are the scenarios where you can import products without mandatory BIS registration:

### Importing Product Samples for Testing & Research

- Importers can bring in product samples without a BIS certificate only for testing, research, and development purposes.
- You must assure customs that the imported goods will be used exclusively for testing and evaluation.
- Limitations: The same model can only be imported once for sampling.
- The customs clearance process must still be followed for approval.

### Importing for Personal Use

- BIS registration is not required if you are importing products for personal use.
- According to the Department of Electronics & Information Technology (DeitY), end-users face no restrictions on bringing in products for personal consumption.

### Temporary Import for Exhibitions & Trade Fairs

- Special permissions are required for temporary display import.
- Must re-export or dispose of items per BIS regulations

## Cost of BIS Certificate for Import

The cost of obtaining a BIS certificate for import varies based on the product type and the applicable certification scheme. The total expense generally includes:

- Application Fee – Charged for submitting the BIS certification request.
- Product Testing Fee – Cost of testing the product in a BIS-recognized laboratory to ensure compliance with Indian Standards.
- Inspection Fee – Covers the cost of BIS officials inspecting the manufacturing facility.
- Marking Fee – Fee for using the ISI mark or CRS mark on the certified product.
- Performance Bank Guarantee (For FMCS Applicants) – Foreign manufacturers applying under the FMCS scheme must deposit a refundable performance bank guarantee of $10,000 with BIS.

The total cost can range from a few thousand to several lakhs of rupees, depending on the complexity and category of the product. For an exact cost estimate, contact our experts today!

## BIS Certification for E-commerce Importers

If an importer sells products via platforms like Amazon, Flipkart, or Shopify, compliance with BIS standards is mandatory.

Key Considerations for E-commerce Importers:

- BIS registration is required for listing electronics, toys, and regulated goods.
- Products without certification may be delisted by online marketplaces.
- Sellers must verify supplier certifications before listing imported goods.
- A BIS-registered importer enjoys greater credibility and trust from buyers.

content_sections.heading: How to Download BIS Certificate?
content_sections.content:
The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification is a hallmark of quality, safety, and reliability for products sold in India. It ensures that goods meet the stringent standards set by the BIS, which operates under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution. After obtaining BIS certification, downloading the certificate is a crucial step for manufacturers and businesses to showcase compliance. This article provides an in-depth guide on how to download a BIS certificate.

content_sections.heading: What is BIS Certification?
content_sections.content:
BIS (Bureau of Indian Standards) Certification is an approval issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) that ensures a product meets Indian quality, safety, and reliability standards. It is mandatory for certain products, especially in categories like electronics, consumer goods, food items, and industrial products.

_[Also read: BIS Certificate for Import](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/bis-certificate-for-imports)_

content_sections.heading: Key Benefits of Downloading a BIS Certificate
content_sections.content: Downloading a BIS (Bureau of Indian Standards) Certificate provides multiple advantages for businesses, manufacturers, and importers. Here are the key benefits:

content_sections.heading: Proof of Compliance
content_sections.content:
- Serves as official proof that the product meets Indian quality and safety standards.
- Ensures compliance with mandatory regulations for specific products like electronics, food, and construction materials.

content_sections.heading: Faster Market Access
content_sections.content:
- Allows businesses to legally sell, manufacture, and distribute products in India.
- Essential for importers and exporters dealing in BIS-regulated goods.

content_sections.heading: Enhances Consumer Trust & Brand Reputation
content_sections.content:
- A BIS-certified product reassures customers of its quality, durability, and safety.
- Strengthens the brand’s credibility in competitive markets.

content_sections.heading: Reduces Risk of Penalties & Legal Issues
content_sections.content:
- Helps avoid fines, product recalls, or bans for selling non-compliant products.
- Ensures smooth regulatory approval and reduces risks of disputes.

content_sections.heading: Simplifies Business Operations
content_sections.content:
- Provides easy verification for retailers, distributors, and government bodies.
- Useful for renewal applications, audits, and compliance checks.

content_sections.heading: Digital Convenience & Time-Saving
content_sections.content:
- Instant online access to the certification document.
- Eliminates the need for physical paperwork and manual verification.

content_sections.heading: Useful for Tenders & Business Contracts
content_sections.content:
- Required for government procurement, tenders, and bulk supply contracts.
- Acts as an eligibility criterion for large-scale business deals.

content_sections.heading: Prerequisites for Downloading a BIS Certificate
content_sections.content:
Before downloading your BIS certificate, ensure that:

- Your product has successfully passed all testing and inspections.
- You have completed the registration process on the official BIS portal.
- All required documents have been submitted and approved by BIS.

content_sections.heading: Step-by-Step Process to Download a BIS Certificate
content_sections.content: Follow these steps to download your BIS certificate:

content_sections.heading: Step 1: Visit the Official BIS Portal
content_sections.content: Go to the official Bureau of Indian Standards website at www.bis.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: Step 2: Log in Using Your Credentials
content_sections.content: Use your registered username and password to log into your account on the BIS portal. If you are not registered yet, create an account by providing necessary details, such as your business name, email ID, and contact information.

content_sections.heading: Step 3: Navigate to the Certificate Management Section
content_sections.content: Once logged in, locate the "Certificate Management" or "My Licenses" section on the dashboard.

content_sections.heading: Step 4: Search for Your Product
content_sections.content: Enter details such as your product name or license number to search for your approved certification.

content_sections.heading: Step 5: Download the Certificate
content_sections.content: Click on the "Download Certificate" button next to your product listing. Save the document in PDF format for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Step 6: Verify Details
content_sections.content:
After downloading, check all details on the certificate, including:

- Product name
- Manufacturer's name
- License number
- Validity period

content_sections.heading: How to Verify a BIS Certificate Online
content_sections.content:
To ensure authenticity, you can verify your BIS certificate online:

- Visit the official BIS website.
- Go to the "Certificate Verification" section under "Online Services."
- Enter details like license number or product name.
- Submit your query to view results confirming the validity of the certificate.

content_sections.heading: Common Issues While Downloading a BIS Certificate
content_sections.content:
Sometimes, users may face challenges while trying to download their certificates. Here are common issues and their solutions:

- Login Issues: If you forget your login credentials, use the "Forgot Password" option to reset them.
- Incomplete Application: Ensure all required documents are uploaded and approved before attempting to download.
- Technical Errors: Clear browser cache or try accessing the portal from another device or browser.
- Pending Fees: Ensure all fees associated with certification are paid in full.

content_sections.heading: Validity of a BIS Certificate
content_sections.content:
BIS certificates are typically valid for 1–5 years, depending on the product category and certification type. Manufacturers must renew their certificates before expiration by submitting renewal applications along with updated documents and fees.

content_sections.content: The certificate is typically available in PDF format, which can be downloaded and printed.

content_sections.content: No, each certificate is issued for a specific product category. If you manufacture multiple products,  separate certifications may be required.

content_sections.content: You must apply for a renewal before the expiration date to continue using the certification legally.

content_sections.content: Yes, foreign manufacturers registered under the FMCS (Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme) can download their certificates from the BIS portal.

# How to Download BIS Certificate?

The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification is a hallmark of quality, safety, and reliability for products sold in India. It ensures that goods meet the stringent standards set by the BIS, which operates under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution. After obtaining BIS certification, downloading the certificate is a crucial step for manufacturers and businesses to showcase compliance. This article provides an in-depth guide on how to download a BIS certificate.

_Need help with BIS Certification? Let IndiaFilings handle the entire process for you!_

[Apply Now!](https://www.indiafilings.com/bis-certification)

## What is BIS Certification?

BIS (Bureau of Indian Standards) Certification is an approval issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) that ensures a product meets Indian quality, safety, and reliability standards. It is mandatory for certain products, especially in categories like electronics, consumer goods, food items, and industrial products.

_[Also read: BIS Certificate for Import](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/bis-certificate-for-imports)_

## Key Benefits of Downloading a BIS Certificate

Downloading a BIS (Bureau of Indian Standards) Certificate provides multiple advantages for businesses, manufacturers, and importers. Here are the key benefits:

### Proof of Compliance

- Serves as official proof that the product meets Indian quality and safety standards.
- Ensures compliance with mandatory regulations for specific products like electronics, food, and construction materials.

### Faster Market Access

- Allows businesses to legally sell, manufacture, and distribute products in India.
- Essential for importers and exporters dealing in BIS-regulated goods.

### Enhances Consumer Trust & Brand Reputation

- A BIS-certified product reassures customers of its quality, durability, and safety.
- Strengthens the brand’s credibility in competitive markets.

### Reduces Risk of Penalties & Legal Issues

- Helps avoid fines, product recalls, or bans for selling non-compliant products.
- Ensures smooth regulatory approval and reduces risks of disputes.

### Simplifies Business Operations

- Provides easy verification for retailers, distributors, and government bodies.
- Useful for renewal applications, audits, and compliance checks.

### Digital Convenience & Time-Saving

- Instant online access to the certification document.
- Eliminates the need for physical paperwork and manual verification.

### Useful for Tenders & Business Contracts

- Required for government procurement, tenders, and bulk supply contracts.
- Acts as an eligibility criterion for large-scale business deals.

## Prerequisites for Downloading a BIS Certificate

Before downloading your BIS certificate, ensure that:

- Your product has successfully passed all testing and inspections.
- You have completed the registration process on the official BIS portal.
- All required documents have been submitted and approved by BIS.

## Step-by-Step Process to Download a BIS Certificate

Follow these steps to download your BIS certificate:

### Step 1: Visit the Official BIS Portal

Go to the official Bureau of Indian Standards website at www.bis.gov.in.

### Step 2: Log in Using Your Credentials

Use your registered username and password to log into your account on the BIS portal. If you are not registered yet, create an account by providing necessary details, such as your business name, email ID, and contact information.

### Step 3: Navigate to the Certificate Management Section

Once logged in, locate the "Certificate Management" or "My Licenses" section on the dashboard.

### Step 4: Search for Your Product

Enter details such as your product name or license number to search for your approved certification.

### Step 5: Download the Certificate

Click on the "Download Certificate" button next to your product listing. Save the document in PDF format for future reference.

### Step 6: Verify Details

After downloading, check all details on the certificate, including:

- Product name
- Manufacturer's name
- License number
- Validity period

## How to Verify a BIS Certificate Online

To ensure authenticity, you can verify your BIS certificate online:

- Visit the official BIS website.
- Go to the "Certificate Verification" section under "Online Services."
- Enter details like license number or product name.
- Submit your query to view results confirming the validity of the certificate.

## Common Issues While Downloading a BIS Certificate

Sometimes, users may face challenges while trying to download their certificates. Here are common issues and their solutions:

- Login Issues: If you forget your login credentials, use the "Forgot Password" option to reset them.
- Incomplete Application: Ensure all required documents are uploaded and approved before attempting to download.
- Technical Errors: Clear browser cache or try accessing the portal from another device or browser.
- Pending Fees: Ensure all fees associated with certification are paid in full.

## Validity of a BIS Certificate

BIS certificates are typically valid for 1–5 years, depending on the product category and certification type. Manufacturers must renew their certificates before expiration by submitting renewal applications along with updated documents and fees.

_Did you know that BIS has raided eCommerce platforms for selling non-certified products? [Click here to find out more!](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/leading-ecommerce-platforms-face-raids-for-selling-nonbis-certified-products)_

## Conclusion

Downloading a BIS certificate is a straightforward yet vital step after obtaining product certification from the Bureau of Indian Standards. By following the outlined steps carefully—registering on the portal, completing documentation, and navigating through the dashboard—you can easily access your certificate in digital format. This document not only signifies compliance but also enhances consumer trust and opens up new business opportunities in both domestic and international markets.

## Get Your BIS Registration Hassle-Free with IndiaFilings!

Ensure your products meet Indian quality and safety standards with a BIS Certification. Avoid delays, legal issues, and compliance hassles—let IndiaFilings handle the entire registration process for you! Our experts provide end-to-end assistance, from documentation to approval, ensuring a fast and seamless certification process.

[Get Started!](https://www.indiafilings.com/bis-certification)

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### 1\. Can I download my BIS certificate without logging into my account?

No, you must log into your registered account on the BIS portal to access and download your certificate.

### 2\. What should I do if I cannot find my certificate on the portal?

Check if your application has been approved, or contact BIS customer support for assistance.

### 3\. Is there any fee for downloading a BIS certificate?

No additional fee is required for downloading an already-approved certificate.

### 4\. Can I share my downloaded certificate with distributors or retailers?

Yes, sharing your certificate helps establish credibility with stakeholders.

### 5\. How long does it take to download a BIS certificate?

Once the certification is approved, you can download it instantly from the BIS portal.

### 6\. What format is the BIS certificate available in?

The certificate is typically available in PDF format, which can be downloaded and printed.

### 7\. Can I use the BIS certificate for multiple products?

No, each certificate is issued for a specific product category. If you manufacture multiple products,  separate certifications may be required.

### 8\. What happens if my BIS certificate expires?

You must apply for a renewal before the expiration date to continue using the certification legally.

### 9\. Can a foreign manufacturer download a BIS certificate?

Yes, foreign manufacturers registered under the FMCS (Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme) can download their certificates from the BIS portal.

### 10\. How do I verify the authenticity of a BIS certificate?

Visit the BIS portal, navigate to the "Certificate Verification" section, enter the license number or product name, and verify the details.

blogs.title: GST Registration Amendment - Changing GST Data

content_sections.heading: GST Registration Amendment - Changing GST Data
content_sections.content:
GST registration amendment may be required in some cases wherein wrong information about the

[taxable person under GST](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/taxable-person-under-gst) has been updated in the GST Portal. In this article, we look at the procedure for correcting mistakes in GST registration certificates such as GST address change, GST name change, GST phone number change, and trade name change in GST.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.content:
Any taxpayer of the following category, registered under GST, can file the amendment of registration application:

- New Registrants & Normal Taxpayers
- TDS/ TCS Registrants, UN Bodies, Embassies & Other, Notified person having UIN
- Non-Resident Taxable Person
- GST Practitioner
- Online Details and Database Access or Retrieval Service Provider

content_sections.heading: Making Changes to GST Registration Certificate
content_sections.content:
If, at any point, while obtaining

[GST registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/gst-registration) or after obtaining GST registration, there are changes to be made to the information furnished to the GST Common Portal, a GST registration amendment application can be filed. In case of changes to the GST registration application or changes to GST registration information, the GST amendment application form GST REG-14 must be signed by the applicant within 15 days of a change in any information. The GST amendment application must be digitally signed by the applicant. [(Know more about signing GST documents).](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/signing-gst-documents-requirement-digital-signature)

content_sections.heading: GST Amendment - Changes to Business Name
content_sections.content:
In case of any GST name changes required for your business, the GST registration certificate need not be cancelled. The existing GST registration can be amended to reflect the new business name. Changes to business name can be updated on the GST portal by filing FORM GST REG-14 within 15 days of change of business name.

On filing the application for a GST name change for your business name, the GST Officer is required to verify the application and approve the amendment to the business name within 15 working days in FORM GST REG-15. On approval, the amendment would take effect from the date of occurrence of the event warranting the amendment.

content_sections.heading: GST Amendment - Changes to Address
content_sections.content:
In case of any

**GST address change** of principal place of business or any additional place of business, GST FORM REG-14 can be filed. For changes to address, proof of address for the new location must be provided in the GST registration amendment application. Accepted proof of address include :

- **For Own Premises:** Any document in support of the ownership of the premises like latest Property Tax Receipt or Municipal Khata copy or copy of Electricity Bill.
- **For Rented or Leased premises:** A copy of the valid Rent / Lease Agreement with any document in support of the ownership of the premises of the Lessor like Latest Property Tax Receipt or Municipal Khata copy or copy of Electricity Bill.
- **For premises not falling under any of the above category:** A copy of the Consent Letter with any document in support of the ownership of the premises of the Consenter like Municipal Khata copy or Electricity Bill copy. For shared properties also, the same documents may be uploaded.
- **For rented/leased premises where the Rent/lease agreement is not available:** An affidavit to that effect along with any document in support of the possession of the premises like copy of Electricity Bill.
- **If the principal place of business is located in an SEZ or the applicant is an SEZ developer:** Necessary documents/certificates issued by Government of India are required to be uploaded.

All GST address changes recorded in the GST portal must be updated within 15 days of change. On making an application for change of GST address, the GST office would approve the change within 15 days. The date of amendment on approval by the Officer would he the date of occurrence of the event warranting the amendment.

content_sections.heading: GST Amendment - Changes to Promoter Information
content_sections.content:
In case of addition, deletion or retirement of partners or directors, Karta, Managing Committee, Board of Trustees, Chief Executive Officer or equivalent, responsible for day to day affairs of the business, a GST amendment application must be filed within 15 days of of such event.

In the new GST amendment application, details of the new promoter including identity proof, address proof and photograph must be provided along with a

[GST Declaration for Authorised Signatory.](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/gst-declaration-format)

On receipt of application for GST amendment, the concerned officer would approve the change or request for additional information within 15 days of application.

content_sections.heading: GST Amendment - Changes to Mobile Number or Email ID
content_sections.content: Any changes to the mobile number or email id mentioned on the GST Common Portal can be made by the Authorised Signatory using his/her digital signature after an online verification process. Changes to mobile number or email ID does not require the filing of GST amendment application or verification by an Officer. Changes to email or mobile number in GST common portal is considered routine changes.

content_sections.heading: GST Amendment - Changes to PAN
content_sections.content: In case of changes to constitution of a business or PAN, then GST Amendment application cannot be made. For changes to PAN only a new GST registration application in FORM GST REG-01 can be submitted.

content_sections.heading: Time Limit for GST Amendment
content_sections.content:
Any change to information updated in the GST common portal must be intimated by the taxpayer within 15 days of occurrence of event leading to the change of information by filing a GST amendment application.

On receiving a GST amendment application, the concerned officer is required to approve the application after due verification within 15 working days from the date of receipt of application. On approval, the amendment shall take effect from the date of occurrence of the event warranting amendment.

If the application for GST amendment is either not warranted or the documents furnished therewith are incomplete or incorrect, then the concerned officer can serve a notice requiring the taxpayer to submit additional information or clarification within 15 days. On receiving the notice, the taxpayer is required to submit clarification or additional information within 7 days. If the information submitted by the taxpayer is acceptable, the officer can approve the application for GST amendment. If the information is not acceptable, then the GST officer can reject the application for amendment.

However, if a GST officer fails to take action within 15 working days of submission of amendment application or within 7 working days of receipt of clarification or additional information in response to a notice, then the certificate of registration shall stand amended to the extent applied for and the amended certificate would be made available to the registered person on the Common Portal.

content_sections.heading: Amendment of Core & Non-Core fields
content_sections.content:
The application for Amendment of Registration can be categorised into two types: - **Application for Amendment of Core fields in Registration:** Core fields are one which requires approval from the jurisdictional officer. - **Application for Amendment of Non-Core fields in Registration:** Non-core fields of GST registration are those that do not require approval from a tax official and will be auto-updated after successful filing, including GST phone number change and trade name change in GST. The following is the tabulation that represents the particulars has been declared as core fields and can be amended: | | | | --- | --- | | **Core fields (Approval Required)** | **Non-Core fields (No Approval Required)** | | Name of the Business
(Legal Name) if there is no change in PAN | All the other fields of registration application except the following:
- legal name of the business,
- Addition/ deletion of stakeholder details
- Principal place of business
- Additional place of business. | | Addition / Deletion of Stakeholders | | Principal Place of Business (other than a change in State) | | Additional Place of Business (other than a change in State) | **Note:** Application for Amendment of Registration cannot be filed when there is a change in PAN, Constitution of Business resulting in the change of PAN, and Place of Business from one State to other.

content_sections.heading: Online Procedure for Amendment Application - Core Fields
content_sections.content: The taxpayers must follow the below procedure to apply for the amendment of Core fields through GST portal.

content_sections.heading: Visit GST Portal
content_sections.content:
**Step 1:** Firstly, the taxpayers have to visit the Goods and Services Tax portal apply for the amendment of Core fields online.

![Step-1-GST-homepage](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-1-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Step 1 -GST homepage

content_sections.heading: Login into Portal
content_sections.content:
**Step 2:** Click on the ‘Login’ button to access the username and password page.

**Step 3:** Enter the correct ‘Username’ and ‘Password’ credentials along with the captcha in the required field and click ‘login’.

![Login-Page](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-3-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Login Page

content_sections.heading: Application to Amendment of Registration Core Fields
content_sections.content:
**Step 4:** After you logged in, you have to select ‘Amendment of Registration Core Fields’ from the Registration Menu under the service tab that is visible on the home page.

![Amendment-of-Registration-Core-Field](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-4-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Amendment of Registration Core Field

content_sections.heading: Business Details Tab
content_sections.content:
**Step 5:** The Business Details tab is selected by default; it displays the information to be filled for the registration of registration period.

- By clicking on the Edit icon, select the field which you want to edit.
- Now edit the desired details and select the Date of Amendment using the calendar.
- You have to enter the reason for amendment of information provided in the Core fields in the Reasons field
- Now click on the Save button.

![Business-Details-Tab](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-5-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Business Details tab

**Step 6:** Click on the continue button once all the changes are made. A blue tick will appear on the Business Details section indicating the completion of the business details.

![Business-Details](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-6-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Business Details

content_sections.heading: Principal Place of Business tab
content_sections.content:
**Step 7:** Scroll down the page and click on the edit button.

- Edit the required fields in the form, if required,
- Enter the reason for amendment of information in the Reasons field,
- Now you have to select the Date of Amendment using the calendar,
- Then click on the Save button.

![Business-Details-GST](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-7-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Business Details GST

**Step 8:** A blue tick will appear on the Principal Place of Business section indicating the completion of the business details.

content_sections.heading: Additional Places of the Business tab
content_sections.content:
**Step 9:** On clicking on the Additional Places of the Business tab, it displays the information to be filled for the addition of places of your business.

![Additional Places of the Business](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-9-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Additional Places of the Business

**Step 10:** You have to enter the number of additional places for which information is to be added in the Number of additional places field

**Step 11:** Then click on the Add New button.

**Step 12:** The portal displays the form for editing. Now proceed forward with editing by clicking on the Edit button.

- You need to enter the reason for amendment in information in the Reasons field.

**Note:** The taxpayer shall upload the documents only in the case of amendment relating to additional place of business.

- You have to select the Date of Amendment using the calendar.
- Now click on the Save & Continue button.
- Finally, you need to click on the Save button.

![Amendment-of-GST-registration](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-12-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Step 12 - Amendment of GST registration

**Note:** You can click on the Edit and Delete button to edit or delete the additional place of your business.

content_sections.heading: Promoter / Partners tab
content_sections.content:
**￼Step 13:** Click on the view button, to view the details of the Promoter or Partners.

**Step 14:** Click on the edit button, to edit the details of Promoter or Partners. To delete the details of the Promoter or Partners, click the delete button.

![Amendment-of-GST-registration](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-14-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Step 14 - Amendment of GST registration

- Click on the ‘add new’ button to add details of Promoter or Partners.
- Now you need to enter the details of the Promoter/Partner and upload the necessary documents required as a proof for the amendment.
- Enter the reason for amendment of information in the Reasons field.
- Now you have to select the Date of Amendment using the calendar.
- Then click on the Save button.
- Click on the continue button after giving all the required details.

content_sections.heading: Verification Details
content_sections.content:
**Step 15:** This verification page displays the details of the verification for authentication of the details submitted in the form.

- You need to select the Verification checkbox.
- In the Name of Authorized Signatory list, select the name of the authorized signatory.
- Enter the 'Place' in the in the Place field in the form.
- Click the Submit with DSC or Submit with EVC button.

content_sections.heading: In Case of DSC:
content_sections.content:
- Click the Submit with DSC button.
- Then click the Proceed button.
- Select the certificate and then click the “sign” button.

![Amendment-of-GST-registration](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-15-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Step 15 - Amendment of GST registration

content_sections.heading: In Case of EVC:
content_sections.content:
- Click the Submit with EVC button.
- Enter the OTP sent to an email address and mobile number of the Authorized Signatory registered through the GST Portal and to validate OTP, click the Validate OTP button.

![EVC](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-15-EVC.png) Step 15 - EVC

content_sections.heading: Acknowledgement Message
content_sections.content:
**Step 16:** The portal displays the message after successful verification. The applicant shall also receive the acknowledgement for completion in the next 15 minutes to the registered e-mail address and mobile phone number. The user shall receive the Application Reference Number (ARN) receipt to the registered e-mail address and mobile phone number.

**Step 17:** After verification, the individual shall receive a notification through SMS and e-mail address stating approved or rejected. The individual can view or download the approval order at the portal. Also, the taxpayer can download the amended registration certificate from the dashboard.

content_sections.heading: Verification Status - Amendments to Core Fields
content_sections.content:
After the generation of ARN for amendment of core field and waiting for the tax authority to process the application, the individual may re-apply for the amendment of the core only if the concerned tax authority disposes of the already applied application for amendment of core.

The verification status shall display any one of the following messages:

- **Pending for Processing -** Amendment Application of Registration application successfully filed, and ARN generated.
- **Pending for Validation -** Waiting for the generation of ARN after submitting the Amendment Application.
- **Validation Error -** In case the validation fails, on submission of the Amendment Application until the process for generating ARN.

content_sections.heading: Online Procedure for Amendment Application – Non-Core fields
content_sections.content:
The taxpayers must follow the below procedure to apply for the amendment of Non-Core fields through GST portal. You can change the amend the details in this Non-core fields including

GST phone number change and trade name change in GST **Step 1:** Click on the ‘Login’ button to access the username and password page.

**Step 2:** Enter the correct ‘Username’ and ‘Password’ credentials along with the captcha in the required field and click ‘login’.

content_sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
content_sections.content:
Common questions aboutGST Registration Amendment.

What is a GST registration amendment?

A GST registration amendment refers to making changes or corrections to the information provided during the initial GST registration process. This could include changes to business name, address, promoter/partner details, mobile number, email ID, or other core and non-core fields.

When should I file a GST registration amendment application?

You should file a GST registration amendment application within 15 days of any change or event that warrants an update to the information provided in your GST registration. Failing to update the details within the stipulated time may attract penalties.

How do I file a GST registration amendment application?

You can file a GST registration amendment application online through the GST portal. For core field changes, you need to submit the GST REG-14 form and obtain approval from the concerned tax officer. For non-core field changes, you can directly update the information on the portal.

What are considered core fields in GST registration?

Core fields in GST registration include business name, principal place of business, additional places of business, and promoter/partner details. Any changes to these fields require approval from the tax officer after filing the GST REG-14 form.

What are non-core fields in GST registration?

Non-core fields in GST registration include mobile number, email ID, and trade name. Changes to these fields can be made directly on the GST portal without requiring approval from the tax officer.

Is there a time limit for the tax officer to approve a GST registration amendment?

Yes, the concerned tax officer is required to approve or reject a GST registration amendment application within 15 working days from the date of receipt. If no action is taken within this time, the amendment is deemed approved.

Can I amend my GST registration if my PAN changes?

No, if your PAN (Permanent Account Number) changes, you cannot amend your existing GST registration. You will need to apply for a new GST registration with the updated PAN.

How do I change my business address in GST registration?

To change your business address in GST registration, you need to file the GST REG-14 form as it is considered a core field amendment. You will also need to provide proof of the new address along with the application.

Can I change my registered mobile number or email ID directly on the GST portal?

Yes, you can change your registered mobile number or email ID directly on the GST portal without filing the GST REG-14 form, as these are considered non-core fields.

What documents are required for a GST registration amendment?

The documents required for a GST registration amendment may vary depending on the type of amendment. For address changes, you may need to provide proof of ownership or rental agreement. For promoter/partner changes, you may need to submit identity and address proofs of the new promoter/partner.

IndiaFilings Expert Published on: **Aug 28, 2026** # GST Registration Amendment - Changing GST Data GST registration amendment may be required in some cases wherein wrong information about the [taxable person under GST](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/taxable-person-under-gst) has been updated in the GST Portal. In this article, we look at the procedure for correcting mistakes in GST registration certificates such as GST address change, GST name change, GST phone number change, and trade name change in GST. ## **Eligibility Criteria** Any taxpayer of the following category, registered under GST, can file the amendment of registration application: - New Registrants & Normal Taxpayers - TDS/ TCS Registrants, UN Bodies, Embassies & Other, Notified person having UIN - Non-Resident Taxable Person - GST Practitioner - Online Details and Database Access or Retrieval Service Provider ## Making Changes to GST Registration Certificate If, at any point, while obtaining [GST registration](https://www.indiafilings.com/gst-registration) or after obtaining GST registration, there are changes to be made to the information furnished to the GST Common Portal, a GST registration amendment application can be filed. In case of changes to the GST registration application or changes to GST registration information, the GST amendment application form GST REG-14 must be signed by the applicant within 15 days of a change in any information. The GST amendment application must be digitally signed by the applicant. [(Know more about signing GST documents).](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/signing-gst-documents-requirement-digital-signature) ## GST Amendment - Changes to Business Name In case of any GST name changes required for your business, the GST registration certificate need not be cancelled. The existing GST registration can be amended to reflect the new business name. Changes to business name can be updated on the GST portal by filing FORM GST REG-14 within 15 days of change of business name. On filing the application for a GST name change for your business name, the GST Officer is required to verify the application and approve the amendment to the business name within 15 working days in FORM GST REG-15. On approval, the amendment would take effect from the date of occurrence of the event warranting the amendment. ## GST Amendment - Changes to Address In case of any **GST address change** of principal place of business or any additional place of business, GST FORM REG-14 can be filed. For changes to address, proof of address for the new location must be provided in the GST registration amendment application. Accepted proof of address include : - **For Own Premises:** Any document in support of the ownership of the premises like latest Property Tax Receipt or Municipal Khata copy or copy of Electricity Bill. - **For Rented or Leased premises:** A copy of the valid Rent / Lease Agreement with any document in support of the ownership of the premises of the Lessor like Latest Property Tax Receipt or Municipal Khata copy or copy of Electricity Bill. - **For premises not falling under any of the above category:** A copy of the Consent Letter with any document in support of the ownership of the premises of the Consenter like Municipal Khata copy or Electricity Bill copy. For shared properties also, the same documents may be uploaded. - **For rented/leased premises where the Rent/lease agreement is not available:** An affidavit to that effect along with any document in support of the possession of the premises like copy of Electricity Bill. - **If the principal place of business is located in an SEZ or the applicant is an SEZ developer:** Necessary documents/certificates issued by Government of India are required to be uploaded. All GST address changes recorded in the GST portal must be updated within 15 days of change. On making an application for change of GST address, the GST office would approve the change within 15 days. The date of amendment on approval by the Officer would he the date of occurrence of the event warranting the amendment. ## GST Amendment - Changes to Promoter Information In case of addition, deletion or retirement of partners or directors, Karta, Managing Committee, Board of Trustees, Chief Executive Officer or equivalent, responsible for day to day affairs of the business, a GST amendment application must be filed within 15 days of of such event. In the new GST amendment application, details of the new promoter including identity proof, address proof and photograph must be provided along with a [GST Declaration for Authorised Signatory.](https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/gst-declaration-format) On receipt of application for GST amendment, the concerned officer would approve the change or request for additional information within 15 days of application. ## GST Amendment - Changes to Mobile Number or Email ID Any changes to the mobile number or email id mentioned on the GST Common Portal can be made by the Authorised Signatory using his/her digital signature after an online verification process. Changes to mobile number or email ID does not require the filing of GST amendment application or verification by an Officer. Changes to email or mobile number in GST common portal is considered routine changes. ## GST Amendment - Changes to PAN In case of changes to constitution of a business or PAN, then GST Amendment application cannot be made. For changes to PAN only a new GST registration application in FORM GST REG-01 can be submitted. ## Time Limit for GST Amendment Any change to information updated in the GST common portal must be intimated by the taxpayer within 15 days of occurrence of event leading to the change of information by filing a GST amendment application. On receiving a GST amendment application, the concerned officer is required to approve the application after due verification within 15 working days from the date of receipt of application. On approval, the amendment shall take effect from the date of occurrence of the event warranting amendment. If the application for GST amendment is either not warranted or the documents furnished therewith are incomplete or incorrect, then the concerned officer can serve a notice requiring the taxpayer to submit additional information or clarification within 15 days. On receiving the notice, the taxpayer is required to submit clarification or additional information within 7 days. If the information submitted by the taxpayer is acceptable, the officer can approve the application for GST amendment. If the information is not acceptable, then the GST officer can reject the application for amendment. However, if a GST officer fails to take action within 15 working days of submission of amendment application or within 7 working days of receipt of clarification or additional information in response to a notice, then the certificate of registration shall stand amended to the extent applied for and the amended certificate would be made available to the registered person on the Common Portal. ## **Amendment of Core & Non-Core fields** The application for Amendment of Registration can be categorised into two types: - **Application for Amendment of Core fields in Registration:** Core fields are one which requires approval from the jurisdictional officer. - **Application for Amendment of Non-Core fields in Registration:** Non-core fields of GST registration are those that do not require approval from a tax official and will be auto-updated after successful filing, including GST phone number change and trade name change in GST. The following is the tabulation that represents the particulars has been declared as core fields and can be amended: | | | | --- | --- | | **Core fields (Approval Required)** | **Non-Core fields (No Approval Required)** | | Name of the Business
(Legal Name) if there is no change in PAN | All the other fields of registration application except the following:
- legal name of the business,
- Addition/ deletion of stakeholder details
- Principal place of business
- Additional place of business. | | Addition / Deletion of Stakeholders | | Principal Place of Business (other than a change in State) | | Additional Place of Business (other than a change in State) | **Note:** Application for Amendment of Registration cannot be filed when there is a change in PAN, Constitution of Business resulting in the change of PAN, and Place of Business from one State to other. ## **Online Procedure for Amendment Application - Core Fields** The taxpayers must follow the below procedure to apply for the amendment of Core fields through GST portal. ### **Visit GST Portal** **Step 1:** Firstly, the taxpayers have to visit the Goods and Services Tax portal apply for the amendment of Core fields online. ![Step-1-GST-homepage](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-1-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Step 1 -GST homepage ### Login into Portal **Step 2:** Click on the ‘Login’ button to access the username and password page. **Step 3:** Enter the correct ‘Username’ and ‘Password’ credentials along with the captcha in the required field and click ‘login’. ![Login-Page](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-3-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Login Page ### Application to Amendment of Registration Core Fields **Step 4:** After you logged in, you have to select ‘Amendment of Registration Core Fields’ from the Registration Menu under the service tab that is visible on the home page. ![Amendment-of-Registration-Core-Field](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-4-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Amendment of Registration Core Field ### Business Details Tab **Step 5:** The Business Details tab is selected by default; it displays the information to be filled for the registration of registration period. - By clicking on the Edit icon, select the field which you want to edit. - Now edit the desired details and select the Date of Amendment using the calendar. - You have to enter the reason for amendment of information provided in the Core fields in the Reasons field - Now click on the Save button. ![Business-Details-Tab](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-5-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Business Details tab **Step 6:** Click on the continue button once all the changes are made. A blue tick will appear on the Business Details section indicating the completion of the business details. ![Business-Details](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-6-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Business Details ### Principal Place of Business tab **Step 7:** Scroll down the page and click on the edit button. - Edit the required fields in the form, if required, - Enter the reason for amendment of information in the Reasons field, - Now you have to select the Date of Amendment using the calendar, - Then click on the Save button. ![Business-Details-GST](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-7-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Business Details GST **Step 8:** A blue tick will appear on the Principal Place of Business section indicating the completion of the business details. ### Additional Places of the Business tab **Step 9:** On clicking on the Additional Places of the Business tab, it displays the information to be filled for the addition of places of your business. ![Additional Places of the Business](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-9-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Additional Places of the Business **Step 10:** You have to enter the number of additional places for which information is to be added in the Number of additional places field **Step 11:** Then click on the Add New button. **Step 12:** The portal displays the form for editing. Now proceed forward with editing by clicking on the Edit button. - You need to enter the reason for amendment in information in the Reasons field. **Note:** The taxpayer shall upload the documents only in the case of amendment relating to additional place of business. - You have to select the Date of Amendment using the calendar. - Now click on the Save & Continue button. - Finally, you need to click on the Save button. ![Amendment-of-GST-registration](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-12-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Step 12 - Amendment of GST registration **Note:** You can click on the Edit and Delete button to edit or delete the additional place of your business. ### Promoter / Partners tab **￼Step 13:** Click on the view button, to view the details of the Promoter or Partners. **Step 14:** Click on the edit button, to edit the details of Promoter or Partners. To delete the details of the Promoter or Partners, click the delete button. ![Amendment-of-GST-registration](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-14-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Step 14 - Amendment of GST registration - Click on the ‘add new’ button to add details of Promoter or Partners. - Now you need to enter the details of the Promoter/Partner and upload the necessary documents required as a proof for the amendment. - Enter the reason for amendment of information in the Reasons field. - Now you have to select the Date of Amendment using the calendar. - Then click on the Save button. - Click on the continue button after giving all the required details. ### Verification Details **Step 15:** This verification page displays the details of the verification for authentication of the details submitted in the form. - You need to select the Verification checkbox. - In the Name of Authorized Signatory list, select the name of the authorized signatory. - Enter the 'Place' in the in the Place field in the form. - Click the Submit with DSC or Submit with EVC button. ### In Case of DSC: - Click the Submit with DSC button. - Then click the Proceed button. - Select the certificate and then click the “sign” button. ![Amendment-of-GST-registration](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-15-Amendment-of-GST-registration.png) Step 15 - Amendment of GST registration ### In Case of EVC: - Click the Submit with EVC button. - Enter the OTP sent to an email address and mobile number of the Authorized Signatory registered through the GST Portal and to validate OTP, click the Validate OTP button. ![EVC](https://img.indiafilings.com/learn/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/Step-15-EVC.png) Step 15 - EVC ### Acknowledgement Message **Step 16:** The portal displays the message after successful verification. The applicant shall also receive the acknowledgement for completion in the next 15 minutes to the registered e-mail address and mobile phone number. The user shall receive the Application Reference Number (ARN) receipt to the registered e-mail address and mobile phone number. **Step 17:** After verification, the individual shall receive a notification through SMS and e-mail address stating approved or rejected. The individual can view or download the approval order at the portal. Also, the taxpayer can download the amended registration certificate from the dashboard. ## Verification Status - Amendments to Core Fields After the generation of ARN for amendment of core field and waiting for the tax authority to process the application, the individual may re-apply for the amendment of the core only if the concerned tax authority disposes of the already applied application for amendment of core. The verification status shall display any one of the following messages: - **Pending for Processing -** Amendment Application of Registration application successfully filed, and ARN generated. - **Pending for Validation -** Waiting for the generation of ARN after submitting the Amendment Application. - **Validation Error -** In case the validation fails, on submission of the Amendment Application until the process for generating ARN. ## Online Procedure for Amendment Application – Non-Core fields The taxpayers must follow the below procedure to apply for the amendment of Non-Core fields through GST portal.
